title: Sr. Manager, Software Development, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video operates one of the largest and most complex streaming infrastructures in the world, serving hundreds of millions of customers across live sports, movies, and TV in more than 240 countries and territories. Ensuring that this infrastructure scales predictably, runs efficiently, and protects customer privacy is foundational to the business. We are hiring a Senior Software Development Manager to own three of the most consequential infrastructure disciplines within Prime Video.

This leader will report directly to the Director of READI and be accountable for how Prime Video plans for scale, drives cost and resource efficiency across core compute and AI infrastructure, and upholds customer privacy as a first-class engineering discipline. This is a broad role that spans predictive capacity planning, deep infrastructure optimization, and privacy engineering — requiring a leader who is equally comfortable in a data-driven forecasting review, an architecture deep-dive on compute and GPU efficiency, and a privacy risk assessment with legal and security partners.

The successful candidate is a seasoned engineering leader who builds and develops high-performing teams, sets multi-year technical strategy, and delivers measurable results in ambiguous, high-scale environments. They will lead through other managers and senior engineers, influence peer organizations and partner teams across Prime Video and AWS, and represent Prime Video’s infrastructure posture to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
PV Scale Forecasting & Capacity Assurance

Own the end-to-end discipline of forecasting demand and assuring capacity across Prime Video’s infrastructure footprint, ensuring the service scales reliably for both predictable growth and peak events (e.g., major live sports, tentpole launches, and global releases).

Own multi-year and event-based capacity models that translate business growth, content strategy, and traffic patterns into infrastructure demand across compute, storage, network, and CDN.

Lead capacity assurance for high-stakes live events, establishing headroom targets, load-testing regimes, and go/no-go readiness reviews with partner teams.

Build a forecasting practice grounded in data science and telemetry — improving forecast accuracy, quantifying confidence intervals, and reducing both over-provisioning waste and under-provisioning risk.

Partner on demand-planning and capacity-management processes with AWS, finance, and PV service teams so that capacity is secured ahead of need at the right cost.

Define the mechanisms (dashboards, reviews, and escalation paths) that give leadership confidence that Prime Video will scale for every moment that matters.

PV Infrastructure Efficiency (Core Compute & AI Infrastructure)

Drive infrastructure efficiency as a durable, measurable engineering discipline across Prime Video’s core compute fleet and its rapidly growing AI/ML infrastructure, materially improving unit economics while protecting reliability and performance.

Set the efficiency strategy and roadmap for core compute (CPU fleets, containerized services, memory/DRAM footprint) and AI infrastructure (GPU/accelerator fleets, training and inference platforms).

Drive down infrastructure cost-to-serve and improve utilization through right-sizing, fleet consolidation, hardware refresh strategy, and adoption of more efficient compute and runtimes.

Optimize the efficiency of AI/ML workloads — GPU utilization, training throughput, inference cost per request — partnering with science and platform teams to eliminate waste in one of PV’s fastest-growing spend areas.

Establish efficiency goals with clear metrics (utilization, cost per stream/request, DRAM and energy footprint) and instrument the fleet so gains are visible, attributable, and durable.

Lead zero-based capacity and efficiency reviews, and represent PV in senior compute-allocation and cost-optimization forums.

PV Privacy

Own privacy as a first-class engineering discipline for Prime Video infrastructure, ensuring that customer data is handled in accordance with Amazon’s privacy commitments and global regulatory obligations by design and by default.

Own the privacy engineering roadmap for PV infrastructure — data handling, minimization, retention, access controls, and auditability across the services and fleets in scope.

Embed privacy-by-design into capacity, compute, and AI infrastructure decisions, ensuring new systems and AI/ML workloads meet privacy requirements before launch.

Partner closely with Legal, Security, and central Privacy teams to translate regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR and regional privacy laws) into concrete engineering controls and mechanisms.

Build the mechanisms that detect, prevent, and remediate privacy risks — tooling, reviews, and metrics that make privacy posture measurable and continuously improving.

Champion a culture of privacy ownership across the team, raising the bar on how PV builds and operates infrastructure that customers trust.

About the team
READI (Reliability, Efficiency, Availability, Defense & Integrity) is the Prime Video organization chartered to keep one of the world’s largest streaming services fast, efficient, resilient, and trustworthy. We sit at the intersection of infrastructure, operations, and customer trust — the team that ensures Prime Video scales for every tentpole launch and live event, spends every infrastructure dollar wisely, and protects customer data by design.

This role anchors three of READI’s most strategic charters — scale forecasting and capacity assurance, infrastructure efficiency across core compute and AI infrastructure, and privacy engineering. You will lead a team of managers and senior engineers, and partner daily with Prime Video service teams, AWS, Finance, Legal, Security, and central Privacy. The work is high-visibility and high-impact: our decisions show up in customer experience during the biggest moments of the year, in Prime Video’s cost structure, and in the trust customers place in how we handle their data.

We are a team that thinks long-term, dives deep on data, and holds a high bar. We invest in our people, promote from within, and give leaders room to set strategy and own outcomes end to end. If you are energized by hard technical problems at massive scale and by building teams that raise the bar, you will fit right in.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- 12+ years of engineering experience
- 12+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience partnering with product and program management teams
- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Communications
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security’s Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon’s security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping Amazon and its customers safe.

We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to drive the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a builder who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems, cares deeply about customer outcomes, and thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals.

Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross-functional team — engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating in this environment and contributing to discussions that span both technical and non-technical domains.



Key job responsibilities
Design & Delivery

* Design and deliver software features and improvements spanning the full lifecycle — including scoping, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance — for major portions of the SecComms platform.

* Design cohesive software implementations for difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks; bring clarity to ambiguous requirements and identify simple, extensible designs.
* Balance constraints across new feature development, technical debt, and operational reliability; limit short-term workarounds in favor of sustainable solutions.
* Produce high-quality, well-tested, documented code that adheres to the Amazon Code Bar and can be maintained and extended by teammates who did not author it.

Operational Excellence

* Demonstrate operational excellence in all work; own and operate production services with appropriate alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and on-call response.
* Actively participate in operational support; identify and resolve the root causes of operational issues rather than accepting the status quo.
* Routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve team operational processes, automation, and tooling — do not settle for operational friction when it can be eliminated.
* Ensure that software failures are addressed with permanent fixes; avoid recurring incidents by addressing systemic causes.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership

* Work closely with security engineers, program managers, communications leads, and partner teams to understand the business and customer value of your software.
* Operate effectively across team and organizational boundaries; collaborate with adjacent teams in an inclusive and constructive manner when integrations, dependencies, or shared priorities arise.
* Balance customer requirements with team requirements; make effective priority tradeoffs between feature development and operational work.
* Communicate clearly and proactively about work in progress, technical decisions, blockers, and scope changes to all relevant stakeholders — both technical and non-technical.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture

* Actively mentor engineers on the team; provide substantive, constructive code review feedback to peers including more senior engineers.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:

As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Security Engineer II, Traffic Quality, Traffic Quality
descriptionHtml:
Advertising at Amazon is a fast-growing, multi-billion dollar business that spans across desktop, mobile and connected devices; encompasses ads on Amazon and a vast network of hundreds of thousands of third party publishers; and extends worldwide. Traffic Quality, within Amazon Advertising, builds technology to detect invalid traffic (IVT) and ensure that Advertiser spend worldwide is directed towards human audiences and protected from ad fraud.

As the Security engineering team within Traffic Quality, we research programmatic advertising risk landscapes to build an understanding of existing and emergent threats. We build specialized techniques to detect and mitigate these threats, contributing to a robust Traffic Quality platform that is a bedrock of advertiser trust and saves hundreds of millions of dollars in ad spend that would otherwise be lost to IVT. The Security Engineering team is responsible for: (a) Targeted threat hunting, including on the dark web, to consistently stay updated on modus operandi and risks associated with advertising fraud, (b) Building sophisticated mitigation techniques through reverse engineering known software, identifying network layer signatures, and conceiving client-side scripting methods, and, (c) Collaborating with security teams across Amazon for sharing intelligence and devising durable detection techniques.

As a Security Engineer in the team, you are passionate about unraveling ad fraud tactics utilizing a diversity of highly specialized skills in reverse-engineering, deep packet inspection of network traffic, understanding of network security, operating systems and browser architectures. You accomplish your tasks by applying expert level knowledge to tools to understand not only what a particular piece of malware for perpetrating ad fraud can do but also how it does it. You work with internal security teams to identify and mitigate botnets, as well as leverage the ethical hacking community to obtain standard modus operandi, source code and tactics used by malware and botnets. The role requires influencing leaders across the company to improve our security bar and protect advertiser trust. A Security Engineer also works with other product and security teams to proactively identify problems and suggest approaches to solve them.

Given the high level of ambiguity in the advertising fraud space, and the need to prepare for unknown unknowns, your creativity, judgement and bias for action will all be key ingredients towards delivering the right results for advertising customers.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
- Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or similar object oriented language
- You have passion for reverse engineering, malware analysis, threat detection and risk hunting.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS products and services
- Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security

title: Lead Electric Propulsion Engineer, Amazon Leo, GNC
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Amazon Leo's Propulsion team designs, tests and builds its own propulsion systems - enabling current and future missions to serve customers. The Lead Electric Propulsion Engineer will provide technical leadership within Amazon Leo's Propulsion Design Engineering team as a subject matter expert for the electric propulsion system. This position demands a combination of technical depth, leadership abilities, and systems engineering experience capable of driving innovation of spacecraft propulsion technologies that ultimately enable customer service via the Amazon Leo satellite constellation. In this role, you will advise test, manufacturing, and mechanical engineers on electric propulsion best practices. Your expertise will directly influence all aspects of propulsion system design and development, including propellant storage and delivery, magnetic circuit design, cathode design, propulsion system architecture, avionics requirements, thermal management, embedded software design, and in-flight concepts of operation (CONOPs).


Key job responsibilities
The Lead Electric Propulsion Engineer supports the system and design throughout the hardware development lifecycle, from conception, prototyping, design validation & test, through production manufacturing, and flight operations. Key responsibilities will include
- impact and influence the full scope of propulsion system design, development, and production including: propellant storage and delivery; thruster magnetic circuit design; cathode design; overall system architecture trades; Propulsion avionics requirements; thermal management; system integration; and propulsion embedded software
- perform detailed system performance and risk analyses to support design trades, risk assessments, and risk mitigation plans
- act with delegated design authority to approve: production non-conformances; changes in design, test, and systems engineering artifacts; and Concepts of Operations for the Amazon Leo Propulsion system
- identify and assess technical risks based on data and outcomes in development, production, and flight operations
- lead or support test execution for development, validation, and risk assessments - especially for integrated tests across multiple large vacuum chambers suitable for testing Hall effect thrusters
- define test plans & test requirements to meet development and production test objectives
- define procedures for in-flight responses to novel off-nominal scenarios, and directly support flight operations as needed
- lead root-cause and corrective-action investigations supported by multidisciplinary engineering teams (e.g. design, manufacturing, test, quality)


A day in the life
The Lead Electric Propulsion Engineer will work within multi-disciplinary teams as the go-to source for electric propulsion knowledge. Teams will work on all aspects of propulsion system development, implementation and production and will require you, as propulsion expert, to ensure the key aspects of device operation are being properly considered and tested within constraints. You will aid in test planning, operation and data analysis, co-author test reports and disseminate impactful results.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- 5+ years of experience with electric propulsion technologies through design or test

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- 7+ years of developing electric propulsion technologies through design & test cycles
- Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE)
- Familiarity with electric circuit design
- Experience with finite element analysis for electromagnetic fields and/or fluid flow

title: Principal Product Manager, Tech, Amazon Connect
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch Amazon Connect has become an AI leader transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Amazon Connect Customer is an AI-native customer experience foundation that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. With Amazon Connect Customer businesses deploy intelligent self-service across voice and digital channels that understands natural language, reasons across knowledge sources, and takes action on behalf of customers. Amazon Connect Customer leverages agentic AI across AWS and Amazon services including Amazon Bedrock Amazon Lex Amazon Polly and Amazon Transcribe to deliver sub-second voice latency human-like conversational quality and self-healing intelligence that detects where AI fails and continuously improves. With this technology we are transforming the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them. A key part of this role is leading the workflow engine and capabilities responsible for enabling both agentic and deterministic experiences across Connect Customer. You will own an engine responsible for orchestrating billions of interaction and tasks across Amazon Connect Customers.

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems while designing beautiful simple user experiences. We are looking for a passionate talented and experienced Product Manager to join Amazon Connect Customer's agentic customer experience team responsible for the capabilities that help companies deliver agentic experiences at scale across all personas. You will play a crucial role in developing the next generation of generative AI infused agent supervisor and end-customer experience capabilities and have the opportunity to design and deliver high-scale resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus. As a Product Manager on our team you will drive strategic initiatives from conception through completion. You will work cross-functionally across teams to solve challenging problems using the latest technologies. You will make data-driven customer-obsessed decisions and work with leadership across AWS to prioritize your programs.

The position is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing business at the cutting edge of applied AI and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will work on agentic systems speech and conversational AI and self-healing feedback loops that are redefining how businesses and their customers interact at scale. You will have the opportunity to design and deliver high-scale resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

This team is a great fit for you if:

You enjoy working with a fun team that prides itself on a great work environment with an inclusive group of people that are working together towards a common goal.

You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in working on a service that will be used directly and indirectly by millions of customers and has a meaningful impact to their functions and interactions.

You'd like to be directly responsible for solving real customer problems.

You are a passionate learner and are motivated to take on new challenges.

You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems but also enjoy work life balance.

Learn more about Amazon Connect: https://aws.amazon.com/connect/.

Key job responsibilities
• Define creative high quality and clear product roadmaps based on customer and stakeholder needs team strategy and vision • Develop detailed crisp business requirements and user stories that can be used to create product specifications and architecture for the capabilities offered • Define target customer segment engage and onboard initial customers and advocate on their behalf to define product vision iteratively • Manage prioritization and trade-offs among needs of various customer and stakeholder groups as well as system performance and scalability. • Create buy-in for product vision and roadmap both internally and across key partners • Proactively identify and resolve issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic or technical goals. • Drive executive communications and alignment on strategy and vision. • Partner with Marketing and other AWS professional services teams to craft a go-to-market strategy to fuel the growth of customer base as well as product feature set

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life-both in and outside of work.

Mentorship & Career Growth. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. descriptionHtml:

- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Shifts will be assigned upon starting in the role and could be subject to change based upon business need.

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Business Intelligence Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our goal is to be earth’s most customer-centric company and to create a safe environment for both our customers and our associates. To achieve that, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. We are looking for a talented business analyst to join the Regulatory Intelligence, Safety & Compliance [RISC] Global Data & Analytics [GDA] team.

This role will be a key member of the Analytics team, responsible for driving analysis and insights to help make meaningful business decisions. As a BIE, you will focus on improving the success within business functions by analyzing data, discovering and solving real world problems, building metrics and business cases to improve customer experience, and providing timely data support for escalations to mitigate risk. We are focused on your success and want to build future leaders within Amazon. A key component of the role is to identify process and system improvement opportunities by developing the right metrics, analyzing data, and partnering with internal teams. In addition, you will design and develop automated reporting solutions to enable stakeholders to manage the business and make effective decisions. Lastly, you will enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.

This role requires an individual with excellent statistical and analytical abilities, deep knowledge of business intelligence solutions and business acumen. The successful candidate will be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and driven by a desire to innovate in this space.


Key job responsibilities
- Creating automated reports and dashboards with a combination of BI tools such as Tableau, Quicksight etc.
- Partnering with Program team, Legal, and Tech stakeholders to understand challenges and provide /analysis to help drive program success
- Providing data support for business and cross-functional partners to address escalations and answer questions using PostgreSQL and AWS solutions
- Uncovering trends and correlations through mining and analysis to develop insights that can help stakeholders to make effective decisions
- Designing and executing analytical projects using statistical analysis
- Build self-service solutions that empower stakeholders to access and analyze data independently.


About the team
Here at Selling Partner Services, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 14 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 10,000+ employees in chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our DEI Ambassador Program. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- 2+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
- Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

title: Startup Partner Solutions Architect, Japan Startups, AWS
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping startup software companies scale globally using the cloud? We're looking for a technical leader to work alongside innovative startup ISVs in Japan, helping them build, monetize, and expand world-class solutions on AWS.

## About Amazon Web Services

At Amazon, our vision is to be earth's most customer-centric company. In 2006, we launched Amazon Web Services, giving customers access to the same cloud technology we built to serve millions of shoppers on Amazon.com. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a secure cloud services platform, offering artificial intelligence, computing power, database storage, content delivery, and other functionality to help businesses scale and grow.

## The Role

As a Startup Partner Solutions Architect, you will be the technical partner to ambitious startup ISVs building on AWS. You'll help them design solutions that scale, guide them to market through AWS Marketplace, and support their expansion across regions — turning great technology into thriving global businesses.

Japan's startup community is producing world-class software companies that are solving real problems for customers worldwide. In this role, you will own the technical relationship with these ISV partners — helping them architect for scale, integrate with AWS services, and craft compelling "better together" stories that resonate with customers.

Your goal is to help startup ISVs become successful AWS Software Partners. You'll work across the full lifecycle — from co-building solutions and navigating technical reviews, through monetization strategy and Marketplace listing, to global expansion across AWS regions.

You'll put exciting ideas to practical use, leveraging a broad set of cloud services across Compute, Storage, Databases, AI/ML, Analytics, and more. You'll help partners understand pricing models, design multi-region architectures, and package their solutions for go-to-market. When partners need to reach customers in markets where they lack local presence, you'll help them build tri-party models with regional Systems Integrators.

Day to day, you'll combine deep technical expertise with commercial acumen — one moment whiteboarding an architecture, the next advising on SaaS pricing strategy or coaching a partner through their Marketplace listing. You'll also provide technical thought leadership through blog posts, case studies, and community outreach.

## Roles & Responsibilities
• Serve as the trusted technical advisor to startup ISV partners, helping them build scalable, well-architected solutions on AWS
• Guide partners through the Foundational Technical Review (FTR) process, raising the bar on solution quality and enabling eligibility for co-sell programs
• Advise on AWS Marketplace monetization strategies — including subscription, usage-based, tiered, and hybrid pricing models
• Help partners design multi-region architectures that operate seamlessly across AWS regions with zero downtime
• Develop go-to-market packaging (T-shirt sized offerings, field-ready kits) in partnership with business development teams
• Create technical content — blog posts, reference architectures, case studies — to showcase partner solutions
• Connect startup customers with the right consulting partners and support unmanaged partners serving the startup segment
• Help emerging consulting partners build repeatable delivery models and advance within the AWS Partner Network

## Culture At Amazon Web Services we don't mind being called "peculiar." We have our own way of doing things. We're obsessed with customers and partners, we see beauty in simplifying the complex, and we're comfortable being misunderstood. Our culture is part of why our people enjoy working in AWS. You will be supported in your career development here at AWS. This includes building your technical consulting and leadership skills. We're passionate about supporting the needs of our people and their family. Benefits include Medical Cover, Employee Assistance Programs, and Global Mobility opportunities.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 7+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Fluent Japanese and business level English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

title: Electrical/Mechanical Engineering Technician - Data Center, TLV DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for an energetic, detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.
The Data Center Engineering Operations Facility Engineer is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. This person serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. DCEO Facility Engineers are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

DCEO Facility Engineer’s are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.


Key job responsibilities
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment.
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures.
- Troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal SLA.
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work.
- Able to work shifts (rotating work days during the weeks).
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment.
- Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of electrical or mechanical experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading and managing operations of critical facilities which require in-depth knowledge in electrical, mechanical, and control systems
- Knowledge of generic mechanical room infrastructure such as chillers, cooler units, and fan controls
- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Mechanical, HVAC systems, Controls)
- Knowledge of key electrical competencies and theory
- Electrical or mechanical journeyman license

title: Mechanical / Electrical Engineer, InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is seeking a collaborative electrical maintenance professional for our Amazon Web Services Team.
This engineering operations technician position serves as the on-site maintenance technician and operator for an AWS data centre.
The Data Centre Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data centre. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its data centres. Data centre equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

EOT’s are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switch-gears, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. This role will not require shift work.

Responsibilities:
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment
- Troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs
- Perform limited maintenance tasks to include: filter changes, HVAC PMs, rack power installs, rack PDU, and rack ATS replacements
- Provide support to Data Centre Operations technicians
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
- Utilise internal CMMS to manage building workflows and spare part inventory
- Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
- Respond to off hour emergency calls per on call rotation for any one of the region’s sites
- Fully comply with all physical security procedures and policies

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

You will need to be a UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels

title: Corporate Counsel, IP, Intellectual Property
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Entertainment Media (GEM) IP team manages trademark and copyright matters across Amazon's entertainment portfolio, including Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, Luna, Audible, Amazon Music, and related media properties. As an attorney on this team, you will work directly with business and legal stakeholders on a wide range of trademark and copyright issues at both the brand and content level, spanning film, live sports, television, gaming, podcasts, and audio entertainment globally.

This role is part of a high-performing team of IP professionals operating across multiple entertainment business lines simultaneously. The position reports to Senior IP Counsel and is based in Culver City, CA, USA.


Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include title clearance and protection; trademark prosecution, maintenance, and enforcement; copyright protection and enforcement; deal negotiation and licensing; dispute management; developing and implementing IP processes and best practices; and counseling business teams across Amazon's entertainment verticals on IP matters.

A day in the life
Your day centers on managing trademark and copyright matters across Amazon's Global Media and Entertainment Businesses - including Amazon MGM Studios, Prime Video, Luna, Twitch, Music, and Audible. You conduct trademark clearances, manage a global trademark portfolio, and develop enforcement strategies — while providing IP counsel to creative, marketing, and product teams on new titles, campaigns, and content launches. You translate complex trademark and copyright issues into actionable recommendations for business stakeholders and senior leadership. You also negotiate IP terms in licensing and distribution deals and build scalable IP processes and best practices across Amazon's entertainment ecosystem.

Basic qualifications

- Juris Doctor and membership in one state bar or equivalent
- 5+ years of post bar admission legal experience
- 5+ years of experience with trademark and copyright matters (including clearance, prosecution, enforcement, licensing, and drafting) related to digital content, filmed entertainment, gaming, and/or audio media.
- Experience managing a trademark portfolio consisting of domestic and foreign marks.
- Experience leading investigations and negotiations to resolve third-party copyright and trademark disputes.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as in-house attorney
- Experience with complex commercial/legal concepts and drafting, ability to quickly read and interpret legal terminology and reasoning
- Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Expert-level knowledge of trademark and copyright issues, opportunities, and best practices for companies in the entertainment and digital media space.
- Experience working across both brand-level and content-level IP matters.
- Experience supporting IP matters in gaming, interactive entertainment, podcasting, audio content, and/or consumer products/merchandising.
- Ability to translate IP issues to members of the creative, marketing, business, management, and legal teams.

title: System I&T Engineer, Amazon Leo for Government (ALG), SEIT | MFG
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a visionary initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging cutting-edge satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Amazon Leo to leverage the constellation of advanced satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

The System Integration & Test (I&T) Engineer will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to design, integrate, and test innovative product solutions. The System I&T Engineer will work closely with colleagues throughout Amazon Leo’s inter-disciplinary team and collaborate with key partners and suppliers to ensure our system exceeds customer expectations. The System I&T Engineer must be responsive, flexible, innovative, and able to succeed within a collaborative, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

As a member of the ALG Engineering Systems Engineering, Integration, Test, and Manufacturing organization, the System I&T Engineer will be responsible for developing the architecture and executing the design, build, and validation of test systems for complex systems and subsystems. The candidate will have the capabilities to develop test procedures, test software, test scripts, APIs, and automation to enable test and verification at various products levels including but not limited to system-on-chip (SoC) calibration algorithm verification, test automation and data analysis for electronics, opto-mechanical/opto-electrical subsystems, and system level tests including environmental tests. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the test architecture supports all aspects of the integration, test, verification, and validation of one or more of the following: the satellite bus, RF payloads, optical payloads, custom ground terminals, or custom user terminals. This includes testing, analyzing, and optimizing the test support equipment to the particular satellite or ground element being developed. Testing efforts include functional and performance testing through various environmental conditions as required and it will be the candidate’s responsibility to ensure the test systems enable efficient test execution and requirements verification.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in space and ground systems design, integration, and verification across the development lifecycle. This candidate should enjoy taking ownership over complex problems and delivering well-executed results of high-quality and can work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that provides significant autonomy to be creative in devising and verifying various engineering approaches to meet technical and programmatic requirements.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.





Key job responsibilities

descriptionHtml:
Are you a results-driven professional who thrives on improving how work gets done? descriptionHtml:

Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:

Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:

descriptionHtml:
Are you an innovative leader that wants to design the next generation of world-class fulfillment centers and logistics systems across the globe? Do you want a high level of ownership in solving complex problems? title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

title: Senior Account Executive , North America, Fulfilled By Merchant Business Development
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a dynamic and motivated Senior Account Executive for our Selling Partner Services team (sell.amazon.com), supporting the North America Fulfilled by Merchant (FBM) organization. This role is chartered with building and managing a pipeline of high-value seller accounts and executing consultative sales and account management strategies that deliver results against bold growth goals.

You will own the full engagement lifecycle for strategic sellers who fulfill orders from their own warehouses, helping them adopt Amazon's automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment solutions. The core of the work is diagnostic and solutions-focused: analyzing a seller's shipping and delivery performance, identifying the gaps that slow their delivery promises, and guiding them to changes that shorten click-to-delivery times, protect their account health, and unlock incremental sales.

Success in this role means building trusted relationships with key decision-makers inside seller organizations, partnering with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams (product, tech, and program), and translating seller pain points into compelling, data-backed recommendations. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-moving space and act as a voice of the seller back into Amazon.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of successful B2B sales or account management experience, preferably in e-commerce, logistics, retail technology, supply chain, or SaaS. Demonstrated success exceeding targets through a consultative, data-driven approach is required, and experience selling nascent products or services into new markets is a strong plus. Candidates must have excellent communication and presentation skills, be comfortable working with data in Excel to build a narrative, thrive in ambiguity, and bring a genuine passion for continuous improvement through collaboration. A bachelor's degree is required.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive a portfolio of high-value seller accounts end to end, from identification and outreach through adoption and launch, consistently surpassing ambitious revenue and adoption targets.
- Influence senior decision-makers within seller organizations, establishing yourself as the strategic authority on fulfillment and delivery performance.
- Diagnose complex shipping and delivery gaps through rigorous data analysis, uncovering root causes that others miss.
- Architect and sell tailored solutions using automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment, tying every recommendation to measurable business impact such as faster delivery promises, stronger account health, and incremental sales.
- Lead cross-functional partners across product, tech, and program to break down barriers and accelerate results.
- Champion the voice of the seller, surfacing recurring pain points and opportunities to shape product and program roadmaps.
- Own pipeline accuracy and forecasting in Salesforce, using data to prioritize effort and report on results.
- Operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, and continuously refine your approach through experimentation and collaboration.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, and that's by design. You own your book of business, so where you invest your time is a strategic decision, not a checklist.

You might open the day inside a seller's shipping data, spotting a pattern in their delivery promises that's quietly costing them sales, then shaping that insight into a recommendation they can't ignore. By midday you're leading a consultative conversation with senior seller leadership, reframing how they think about fulfillment and earning their commitment to change.

In the afternoon you partner with a product team to escalate a pain point you've diagnosed across multiple accounts, influencing the roadmap with evidence, not opinion. Throughout, you're deciding where to go deep and where to move on.

You thrive in ambiguity, make judgment calls without a playbook, and are measured not by activity, but by the outcomes you drive and the trust you build.

About the team
We are the North America Strategic MFN (Merchant Fulfilled Network) team, part of Selling Partner Services. We partner with sellers who fulfill orders from their own warehouses, helping them use Amazon's automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment solutions to deliver faster, protect their account health, and grow their business.

We work in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where the playbook is still being written, which means the ideas you bring genuinely shape how the program evolves. We value diverse perspectives, learning through experimentation, and supporting each other. We take our work seriously, and we take care of each other while we do it.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 7+ years of B2B or enterprise sales with a focus on hunting new business experience
- Experience proactively growing customer relationships within an account while expanding their understanding of the customer's business
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software

Preferred qualifications

- Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
- Experience in e-commerce (sales or marketing)
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience in e-commerce, logistics, supply chain, retail technology, or SaaS.
- Track record of thriving in ambiguity and translating incomplete information into clear, decisive action.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon MGM Studios Financial Systems
descriptionHtml:
Ready to lead the successful integration of MGM's financial systems into Amazon?

Join Amazon MGM Studios Tech as the single-threaded owner of a multi-year program that migrates MGM's financial systems and the significant balance-sheet exposure and annual P&L activity they carry, out of multiple legacy platforms and into a single consolidated Amazon architecture. The Principal Technical Program Manager is a leadership role where you'll set strategic technical direction and drive a transformative, cross-organizational initiative spanning multiple business workstreams, a large portfolio of new deal types, across several engineering organizations, and a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, with a firm deadline to fully deprecate MGM's legacy ERP and complete the integration.

What You'll Do:
- Own and deliver an ambiguous, very large, and complex program that spans multiple organizations and technology domains, serving as the single-threaded owner for all program-level milestones across several bespoke business workstreams (including international and domestic theatrical distribution, third-party content licensing, development and production, streaming, and production facilities).
- Design and own the end-to-end data migration and cutover strategy that moves all financial data (master, transactional, and reference data) from legacy systems to the consolidated platform, spanning the full stack across business, middleware, financial automation, downstream financial infrastructure, and legacy systems to deprecate.
- Develop workback plans per workstream, sequence migrations to manage operational risk, and coordinate with the studio's legal entity restructure, owning the sequencing trade-offs of its circular dependency with the program's builds.
- Own the standardization and graduation framework — define deal-type primitives, establish system-of-record boundaries, enforce standard-versus-exception rules, and determine when each workstream is ready to transition from the program to BAU ownership.
- Identify risks and opportunities in technical strategies, system architectures, and engineering organizational structures, resolving cross-workstream dependencies and engineering capacity gaps.
- Influence and advise VP-level leadership across multiple Finance Technology and Studios Technology organizations — plus Finance, Accounting, Tax, and FinOps — on technical investment decisions, organizational alignment, and long-term platform strategy, making priority calls based on business value, partner readiness, and platform reuse.
- Author the program's strategic narratives, define program-level tenets, and run the operating cadence (monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership, and ad-hoc executive escalations).
- Drive clarity in a highly ambiguous environment where business strategy, architectural approach, and even the problem definition may not yet exist.

What You Bring:
- 10+ years of technical program management experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering very large, cross-organizational programs.
- Deep expertise in large-scale systems and platform architecture, and the ability to evaluate and influence architectural strategies across multiple engineering organizations.
- Executive-level communication and influence skills, with experience advising VP-level leaders and aligning competing priorities across organizational boundaries — without direct line authority.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes at scale.
- Experience making irreversible sequencing decisions in complex migrations and managing controllership and operational risk.

Why This Role Matters:
As the Principal TPM for this program, you won't just execute, you'll define how MGM's financial systems are successfully integrated into Amazon and rebuilt for the next decade. You'll make the irreversible calls: which businesses cut over first, when to freeze legacy systems, how to manage the circular dependency between the entity restructure and the program's builds, and which requirements to simplify without impacting customers. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives alignment across senior leaders with competing roadmaps, and delivers outsized, measurable business value and productivity impact.

This role reports to a Senior Manager of Software Development and regularly presents to VP-level leadership across the program's Steering Committee.

Join us in building the future of entertainment finance!

About the team
Prime Video (PV) Financial Systems (FinSys) calculates, pays, receives payments, accounts for and reports all financial activities to operate a digital streaming and studios business. We manage the onboarding of commercial contractual terms and enable seamless monetization of content and assets through mechanisms like PV related purchases, rentals, subscriptions, ads and theatrical releases. We are successful when we have earned the trust of our customers and they are delighted with our solutions. This drives selection growth for Prime Video and the other businesses we support.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 10+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience working at a TV Network, broadcaster, or an online streaming platform, specializing in digital video delivery or streaming media technologies
