We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Technician, you are a primary resolver for your support team, and are skilled at troubleshooting one or more operating systems. You are able to troubleshoot and solve all but the most complex infrastructure issues. Issues are escalated to the appropriate resolver groups when necessary. You create and maintain documentation on technologies you support and are able to convey SOPs to junior staff. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support. You know how to innovate and make decisions on his/her own, but also know how to take direction when it is given, paying attention to all details involved.

You are able to execute small projects on your own and work with your manager in planning and executing larger local projects. You act as an escalation point for junior technicians. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support.

Position may include rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day/night work weeks, and may change based on the needs of the business. Travel may be required up to 10% of the time. This position will fill an opening at one of multiple separate sites.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Prime Video Resilience, Prime Video App Experience
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about making sure millions of viewers can enjoy their favorite content without interruption? The Prime Video Resilience team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to help us ensure our services are ready to scale safely and efficiently. We sit at the core of Prime Video's resilience layer, where we identify scalability blockers, build frameworks and tools that let service teams handle massive concurrent viewership, and do it all without impacting real customers.

You will design and deliver solutions that enable other engineering teams to focus on business logic while your work quietly ensures their services can scale. If you enjoy solving complex systems problems, thinking about graph patterns and distributed architectures, and shipping tools that have organization-wide impact, this role will give you that opportunity.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build scalability testing frameworks and tools that help Prime Video services validate their readiness to support millions of concurrent viewers safely and without customer impact.
- Identify and resolve scalability blockers across services by analyzing system dependencies, load characteristics, and failure modes, then implementing permanent fixes at the root cause.
- Collaborate with service teams across Prime Video to help them understand scalability challenges and adopt the frameworks your team builds, coaching them on best practices along the way.
- Contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards on requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — while maintaining high code quality and clear documentation.
- Evaluate new approaches and technologies for scale-readiness tooling, recommending adoption where appropriate and keeping your solutions straightforward rather than over-engineered.

A day in the life
You will spend much of your time working independently — diving deep into system architectures, profiling service behavior under load, and writing code for the tools and frameworks that power Prime Video's scale-readiness program. On other days, you will partner with service teams to walk through their scalability challenges, propose solutions, and help them integrate your tooling. As an individual contributor, you will balance heads-down engineering with collaborative problem-solving sessions, gaining broad exposure to the systems and patterns that keep Prime Video running at scale.

About the team
The Prime Video Resilience team is responsible for ensuring that Prime Video's services can scale to meet the demands of millions of concurrent viewers worldwide. We build the frameworks, tools, and approaches that let service teams prove their scale readiness efficiently, so they can stay focused on delivering great customer experiences. Our work has organization-wide impact, and we are always looking for new ways to make scalability validation simpler and more effective. If you want to grow your expertise in distributed systems, graph patterns, and large-scale architecture while shipping solutions that matter across Prime Video, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. descriptionHtml:

You will be working directly with the most important customers (across segments) in the GenAI model training and inference space helping them adopt and scale large-scale workloads (e.g., frontier models) on AWS, developing GTM plans, external/internal evangelism, and developing demos and proof-of-concepts.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Key job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:

-Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce

-Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact

-Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance

-Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises

-Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives

-Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

This role sits at the intersection of content, advertising, and marketing - working cross-functionally to improve demand for PV advertising products, deliver brand partner relationship revenue goals, and maximize the value of remnant ad inventory.

You will enable Ads sales and marketing teams with compelling insights and materials, manage end-to-end title brand partnership programs, and develop strategies to leverage house ads inventory for broader Prime Video KPIs. This is a high-visibility role requiring the ability to operate across multiple parallel workstreams, influence senior stakeholders across PV, Ads, Legal, PR, and Finance, and deliver results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.


Key job responsibilities
Ads Product Marketing
• Work cross-functionally with the Ads GTM team to build relevant insights and messaging that engage and build affinity with advertisers
• Partner with the Ads Event Marketing team to activate PV Ads messaging at key industry events
• Support the launch of new PV Ads programs and product features via GTM planning, monitoring tests, and providing visibility to stakeholders
• Identify critical insights from the ad sales process and craft clear, advertiser-facing marketing materials
Brand Partnership Program Management
• Manage the end-to-end process for title partnerships across PVA and Live Events, delivering against revenue goals
• Work cross-functionally with Ads GTM, Legal, and PV O&O Marketing to develop exciting, advertising-friendly packages against key Amazon Originals, licensed titles, and multi-title packages
• Partner with PV Content and Legal teams to secure partnership-eligible titles and navigate content rights
• Collaborate with PV Marketing to develop advertiser-facing materials for partnership titles
• Work with Finance to ensure brand partnership revenue is correctly attributed to titles
House Ads Strategy & Operations
• Develop strategy for allocating remnant PV ad inventory (e.g., from PVA, Live Events) to drive non-ads PV KPIs
• Partner with WW and local Finance and BI teams to develop House Ads reporting mechanisms
• Work with WW PVA and local Marketing teams to source marketing assets
• Build House Ads supply into Live Events in partnership with Ads teams
• Advocate for increase/decrease of inventory supply for House Ads based on performance data

Basic Qualifications:
• 5+ years of program management, product marketing, or advertising operations experience
• Experience managing programs with multiple parallel workstreams at different stages of a product lifecycle
• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across marketing, sales, legal, finance, and content teams
• Experience crafting clear, customer-facing marketing materials for B2B audiences
• Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in advertising sales, media, or entertainment industries
• Understanding of content rights and licensing in media markets
• Experience with sponsorship or brand partnership programs
• Familiarity with advertising metrics, revenue attribution, and GTM planning
• Ability to influence stakeholders (including PR and Legal) to support advertising goals


Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

title: Quality Assurance Engineer, FBA
descriptionHtml:
READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?

How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, creating a seamless experience to leverage our world-class infrastructure. Sellers, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, in 135 countries worldwide, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces.

Our team is working to solve what is arguably the most difficult eCommerce problem that exists today: building sophisticated, scalable technology to effectively simplify the complexity of connecting millions of FBA sellers with hundreds of millions of consumers who buy their products. Even small improvements result in millions of dollars in savings for our sellers and customers. Given the importance of small and medium sized businesses, these savings are what helps drive the global economy.

Specifically, the Send to Amazon - STA Platforms (STAP) team is part of the broader Inbound Workflows and Platforms organization. The STAP team owns the user interface platform that enables sellers to inbound products to Amazon. As the owners of this platform, the STAP engineering team is responsible for the codebase, development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and providing on-call support. The team is also accountable for the inbounding workflow built on this platform, which supports a wide range of marketplaces categorized as "Worldwide" (WW). This encompasses the end-to-end engineering and quality assurance for the seller-facing UI on Seller Central. Additionally, the STAP team owns various services that they have inherited over time from other teams. The QA team within STAP specifically owns manual feature and regression testing across multiple initiatives, both within the inbound workflows organization and beyond.

We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing our team great flexibility in product and technology direction. Come, join us and build the future!


Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plan, automation, and methodologies to ensure the quality and reliability of software products.
- Collaborate and influence cross-functional teams including developers, product managers, and project managers to understand software quality requirements and design effective test strategies.
- Define release planning and provide input on the readiness of software for production deployment.
- Work with component teams to identify the pain points in their area and provide technical guidance.
- Create, maintain, and execute test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for various software components, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing.
- Identify and document defects, issues, and potential areas of improvement in the software development process.
- Perform root cause analysis of complex issues and work with the development team to resolve issues and enhance the overall product quality.
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in QA and testing, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve testing processes.
- Define key metrics for measuring and reporting on the quality of software products and test effectiveness.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience scripting or coding
- Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
- 5+ years of delivering test frameworks, test tools, leading the QA projects and initiatives experience
- Knowledge of QA methodology and tools, with demonstrated experience in an QAE role
- Excellent English written and verbal skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Knowledge of at least one modern object-oriented programming language such as C++, Java, Objective C
- Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
- Experience in leading/coordinating work for other test teams

title: Aerospace Transformation Business Dev leader, Auto & Manufacturing Industry Specialists and Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to join the Industry Specialists team and help build our dedicated Aerospace footprint across NAMER.

In this role, you will own business development for aerospace workloads across the commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space value chains — including supply chain optimisation, predictive maintenance and MRO, digital twin and PLM, connected aircraft, and AI/ML for engineering.

You will engage directly with C-suite executives and VPs at leading European airframe OEMs, propulsion suppliers, Tier-1 systems integrators, and MRO providers to translate their most complex operational challenges into cloud-enabled opportunities, build a qualified pipeline, and shape AWS's aerospace-specific go-to-market plays and partner motions.

The ideal candidate will have deep aerospace industry expertise combined with a business development, consulting, or solutions background — with demonstrated experience engaging CxO/VP-level stakeholders at major aerospace companies.

You should understand the tightly coupled aerospace value chain, where product design changes, certification delays, and supply constraints cascade across company boundaries.

This is an individual contributor role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, can create structure where none exists, and has the ownership and scrappiness to incubate a new segment from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
Build and execute the NAMER aerospace BD strategy aligned with the global OneAWS Aerospace roadmap, identifying priority customer targets, use cases, and partnership opportunities across commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space segments.
Engage C-level and VP stakeholders (CEO, COO, CTO/CIO, VP Engineering, VP Supply Chain, VP MRO, VP Digital) at target European aerospace companies to understand their strategic priorities, build trust, and position AWS as a long-term transformation partner.
Develop and manage a high-quality business development pipeline by identifying, qualifying, and advancing opportunities across aerospace-specific workloads: supply chain visibility and optimisation, MRO predictive maintenance, digital twin and simulation, PLM modernisation, connected product / IoT, compliance (CMMC/ITAR), and AI/ML for engineering.
Lead the "Reuse, Adjust, Build" approach for NAMER — leveraging proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions (digital twin, predictive maintenance, supply chain, IoT) and adapting them for aerospace-specific requirements such as MRO workflows, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), sovereignty, and aircraft lifecycle management.
Drive strategic partner motions with ISVs and system integrators to create differentiated joint solutions for aerospace customers.
Provide thought leadership on aerospace digitisation through executive briefings, industry events, workshops, and published content — positioning AWS as the aerospace industry provider with production-grade AI deployments and measurable business outcomes.
Leverage Pan-Amazon proof points to build credibility and demonstrate how AWS technologies solve real-world aerospace challenges at scale.
Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS field sales (AWSI, AGS), solutions architects, professional services, WWPS (for defense-adjacent workloads), partner teams, and product teams — acting as the single-threaded aerospace specialist who brings coherence across organisational boundaries.
Serve as the "voice of the customer" internally, synthesising aerospace-specific market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer feedback to influence AWS product and solution development.

A day in the life
A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role — and that's the point. You might spend the morning in Seattle whiteboarding on how to modernise PLM architecture, and the afternoon on a call with a Tier-1 engine manufacturer's VP of MRO exploring how predictive maintenance could cut unplanned downtime. In between, you're swapping notes with your partner counterpart on a joint MRO workshop you're co-building, or briefing an AWS Solutions Architect on a customer's sovereignty and ITAR constraints before a technical deep-dive.

On any given week, you could find yourself:

Preparing an executive briefing for a CSCO who wants to understand how AWS can help untangle a multi-tier supply chain visibility problem
Co-developing an aerospace-specific use case (digital twin, engine health monitoring, connected aircraft) with the SA team to present at industry events
Reviewing competitive intelligence and drafting a plan leveraging Pan-Amazon proof points
Running an internal "Aerospace Deep Dive" to educate field sales on why generic manufacturing messaging doesn't land with aerospace customers
Aligning with the WWPS team on CMMC compliance positioning for a defense-adjacent account
Updating shared account plans and tagging opportunities in the CRM so the broader team has visibility
Drafting a 2-pager for leadership on a market signal or a customer win that could shape the GTM playbook

The common thread: you're always at the intersection of deep industry knowledge and cloud technology, building credibility with senior aerospace leaders while creating structure and momentum in a segment AWS is standing up from scratch.

About the team
AWS is building a dedicated Aerospace go-to-market capability within the Industry Specialists organisation. Our approach leverages the deep structural overlap between aerospace and our proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions portfolio — reusing what works, adjusting for aerospace-specific requirements, and building only where critical gaps exist.

We combine AWS's breadth in AI/ML, IoT, HPC, and sovereign cloud with Pan-Amazon proof points (Leo, Amazon Air, Robotics) and a curated partner community to deliver measurable outcomes — not generic cloud messaging.

If you're energised by the prospect of building a new industry vertical from the ground up, working with some of the world's most iconic aerospace companies, and shaping AWS's position in a market where the next 12–18 months will define competitive positioning for a decade — we'd love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- - 8+ years of experience in the aerospace industry — in roles such as business development, management consulting, solution sales, product management, or programme management — spanning one or more of: commercial aviation, defense, space, or MRO.
- - Demonstrated track record of engaging and influencing C-level and VP executives at major aerospace companies (OEMs, engine manufacturers, Tier-1 suppliers, or MRO providers).
- - Strong understanding of the aerospace value chain and its key operational challenges: supply chain complexity and multi-tier visibility, MRO and predictive maintenance, digital engineering and PLM, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), and sovereignty requirements.
- - Familiarity with enterprise platforms and technologies used in aerospace (e.g. SAP, PTC Windchill, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Teamcenter, IFS) and how cloud and AI/ML technologies complement or transform them.
- - Proven ability to develop and execute market development strategies in complex, matrixed environments that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue results.
- - Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to create compelling narratives for both business and technical audiences at the executive level.

Preferred qualifications

- - MBA or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or related field.
- - Experience with aerospace-specific technologies and concepts: digital twin for aircraft simulation and fleet monitoring, predictive maintenance for engine health and component failure, MRO transformation, HPC for CFD/structural analysis, CMMC/ITAR compliance frameworks, and connected aircraft / IoT.
- - Experience working with or for a major aerospace company (e.g. Airbus, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Thales, Leonardo, BAE Systems) or a management consultancy on aerospace transformation engagements (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Roland Berger, Deloitte, Accenture, Capgemini).
- - Established network of C-level and VP relationships across the European aerospace ecosystem.
- - Understanding of the defense-industrial base and its intersection with commercial aerospace — including dual-use technology considerations and cross-sector compliance requirements.
- - Track record of evangelising new technologies at aerospace industry events (Farnborough, Le Bourget, MRO Europe, Paris Air Forum, Aeromart).
- - Experience incubating new market segments or industry verticals — building go-to-market from zero, not just executing established playbooks.
- - Proficiency in French is a strong advantage given the Toulouse/Paris aerospace hub; German, Italian, or Spanish are a plus.
- - Willingness to travel across EMEA and occasionally to the US (estimated 30–40%).

title: HR Partner, Human Resources, AMZL HR
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Partner role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development and HR operational excellence.

As an HR Partner on the AMZL PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. Success in this role comes from building strong partnerships, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining a customer-centric approach. You'll learn to use data-driven insights and HR technologies to enhance the employee experience while developing core HR capabilities that will serve as the foundation for your career growth.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.


Key job responsibilities
Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported.

- Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions.

- Provide frontline employee support by responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and ensuring appropriate resolution or escalation of employee matters. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

- Assist in running and monitoring feedback channels such as roundtables, floor walks, and employee engagement activities. Support issue tracking and follow-up, partnering with senior PXT team members to drive resolutions and improvements in employee experience.

- Coach frontline leaders on behaviors that impact engagement and retention. Reinforce expectations and guide leaders in selecting and effectively utilizing available tools to improve team communication, recognition, and performance conversations.

- Support the execution of site-level engagement, communication, and culture-building initiatives. Coordinate logistics, gather feedback, and monitor effectiveness.

- Learn to track and summarize PXT-related data (e.g., attrition/attendance trends, hiring data, employee sentiment). Help prepare insights for site reviews or team discussions.

- Promote the use of self-service tools to resolve routine employee and manager questions. Help identify recurring gaps and escalate opportunities to improve tool usability or adoption.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing standard work execution with responsive employee support. You'll maintain consistent presence on the operations floor, engaging directly with hourly employees and partnering with leaders to address concerns and drive engagement initiatives. Operating under the guidance of senior team members, you'll execute core HR processes while ensuring quality service delivery.

Through data tools and HR technologies, you'll assist in tracking metrics and identifying trends, while developing your ability to build trust through personal interaction. You'll support employee engagement activities, help coordinate feedback channels, and assist in coaching and development of others. When complex issues arise, you'll seek guidance from senior team members, learning to navigate challenging situations while developing sound judgment.

Success in this role comes from maintaining organized routines, demonstrating strong follow-through, and building effective partnerships with both the PXT team and operations leaders. This role requires excellent organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon experience with 1-year human resources general experience or equivalent experience (e.g., operations, customer service, retail, manufacturing) experience
- Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., creating documents in Word, using basic spreadsheet functions in Excel, managing calendars/emails in Outlook).
- Ability to maintain confidentiality in handling sensitive information
- Experience communicating effectively with diverse audiences (e.g., explaining processes, addressing concerns, providing technical guidance)

title: Principal Delivery Consultant, Emerging Technologies – Sports Industry
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 6, 2026

The AWS Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Principal Delivery Consultant, Emerging Technologies — Sports. In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical leader recognized broadly, both within AWS and across the industry, for your domain-leading expertise. Your work will be primarily strategic: you will amplify impact by shaping outcomes with senior leaders, influencing technology and business strategies across the vertical, and creating scalable mechanisms that define best practices at scale.

You will own the full engagement lifecycle — from leading discovery sessions and defining target-state architectures through designing, building, and deploying production solutions for Sports customers. Your day-to-day work will center on building ML training and inference pipelines, implementing RAG architectures and prompt engineering, orchestrating agentic workflows, and configuring media processing workflows. You will partner with AWS Service teams to drive roadmap prioritization and incubate new capabilities across professional leagues, collegiate athletics, streaming platforms, studios, and live event venues.

Drawing on familiarity with broadcast and OTT content delivery workflows, venue IoT and edge computing, and fan engagement platforms, you will guide stakeholders through emerging technologies — including generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, and modern data platforms. You will identify patterns across customers, develop new architectural principles, and create reusable intellectual property that drives innovation at scale, while managing up to four concurrent engagements.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that helps customers realize their desired business outcomes on the AWS Cloud. Working alongside customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN), we deliver focused guidance through specialty practices spanning a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:

Owning the full engagement lifecycle for Sports customers: leading discovery sessions, defining target-state architectures, building proof-of-concept solutions, designing and implementing production-grade cloud solutions, and ensuring adherence to Well-Architected best practices

Building and deploying AI/ML solutions including ML training and inference pipelines, RAG architectures with prompt engineering, agentic workflow orchestration, and media processing workflows for industry use cases such as fan engagement, venue operations, content workflows, and media production

Designing and implementing data platform solutions using lakehouse and medallion architectures, streaming pipelines, and open table formats to support analytics and AI workloads for sports and media customers

Building reusable architectural artifacts, developing new design patterns by identifying trends across the vertical, and partnering with AWS Service teams on roadmap priorities

Mentoring team members, leading knowledge-sharing initiatives, and contributing to the practice's emerging technology roadmap to grow organizational capabilities

A day in the life
Your morning begins whiteboarding an Agentic AI architecture with an NFL franchise to transform fan engagement. Mid-morning, you review a generative AI proof-of-concept for a studio's content workflow against Well-Architected best practices.

At lunch, you mentor teammates on computer vision for venue operations. Afternoon shifts to presenting a business case to C-level executives at an MLS club, securing a funded engagement.

Late afternoon, you collaborate with AWS Service teams on roadmap priorities, then finalize a reusable reference architecture for the vertical. You close the day reviewing portfolio metrics and drafting strategic recommendations for senior leadership.

About the team
The Emerging Technology Team within AWS ProServe NAMER serves as the nucleus of customer cloud transformation, orchestrating the adoption and scaling of technologies across enterprise and government organizations. The team consists of consultants with deep expertise spanning AI/ML, generative AI, data analytics, IoT, computer vision, robotics, quantum computing, and more.

Their mission centers on transformation consulting, emerging tech-led adoption expertise, and deep industry context. Leveraging Emerging Tech Adoption Framework (ETAF), they help customers envision, prototype, and scale emerging technologies using a risk-aware, portfolio-based investment approach accelerating business outcomes while developing the next generation of AI solutions.

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating. That's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture: Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth: We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Area Manager, Early Career (2027)
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types: https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers: https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.

Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.

Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.

End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program for Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, FBA
descriptionHtml:
Software Development Engineer III — AI-Native Engineering Systems, FBA
WANT TO BUILD AI SYSTEMS — NOT CARRY A PAGER?
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) lets sellers worldwide leverage Amazon's world-class logistics infrastructure — storage, fulfillment, delivery, returns — as a service. Sellers from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses in 135+ countries rely on FBA, which powers tens of billions in annual GMS across dozens of categories.
Most engineering teams spend their best hours reacting — triaging tickets, babysitting deployments, answering the same operational questions over and over. We're building the opposite team. Our entire charter is to build the AI-native systems that make reactive work disappear: agents that resolve operational issues before a human sees them, self-healing pipelines that deploy without manual gates, and a knowledge foundation that lets software answer for itself. You won't be absorbing FBA's operational load — you'll be engineering it out of existence.
This is a VP-funded, multi-year charter with end-to-end ownership and a leadership-backed mandate. You'll work at the frontier of applied AI — LLM-powered remediation agents, machine-readable operational knowledge, autonomous deployment systems — and see your work adopted across 55+ teams and 500+ engineers. We operate with startup intensity inside Amazon: small teams, fast cycles, and the freedom to invent.

Why this team is different

Build systems, not backlog. Your job is to invent AI-native tooling — not to sit in an operational queue. Your work is measured by how much reactive toil it eliminates for other teams.
AI at the core, not bolted on. You'll ship LLM-powered remediation agents, autonomous workflows, and a knowledge foundation that makes AI-assisted development the default across FBA — real production systems, not prototypes.
Learn from the best. You'll join a dedicated pod with direct access to multiple senior and Principal SDEs for design guidance, code review, and mentorship — with a clear path to grow your scope and visibility on a VP-sponsored charter.
Provable impact. Your systems free up the equivalent of dozens of engineers across FBA — measured, visible, and tied directly to a leadership-backed goal.
What you'll build

Agentic remediation systems — LLM-powered agents that detect, diagnose, and resolve operational issues automatically, replacing manual runbooks with self-executing guidance.
Self-healing deployment platforms — safe primitives, automated integration testing, and pipeline intelligence that drive teams toward fully continuous, hands-off delivery.
The FBA knowledge foundation — the OE infrastructure and knowledge-graph tooling that let AI systems reason about FBA's services and answer operational questions autonomously.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 2+ salaried employees and 70+ indirect employees
- Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
- Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
- Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
- Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals

title: Business Intelligence Engineer Intern Germany
descriptionHtml:
2027 Business Intelligence Engineer Internship in Germany

6 MONTHS INTERNSHIP

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.

How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

Do you enjoy solving complex problems and troubleshooting products? Are you passionate about developing test strategies, finding, and tracking bugs to resolution, and innovating on behalf of customers? Do you want to be a part of a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and contribute to one of the most visited sites on the Internet?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate on behalf of our customers. The intense focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Business intelligence engineers use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand.

The challenges business intelligence engineers solve for at Amazon are big and affect millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. Our path is not always simple, so we are selective about who joins us on this journey. There is a certain kind of person who takes on this role at Amazon – someone who is excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company whose ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

The Amazon University Talent Acquisition Team are looking for ambitious students to join us as interns at the heart of our core consumer business! Internships are flexible in length to fit in with your university’s placement scheme.


Key job responsibilities
- Develop analytical solutions to business problems that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor and data integrity
- Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation
- Write high quality code to retrieve and analyze data
- Analyze and solve business problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
- Design pragmatic analyses and automated metrics that add value to your business area
- Understand data resources and how, when, and what to use (and what not to use).
- Develop analyses (whether fully formed or exploratory) for the business’ sake, not for analyses’ sake
- Seek to understand the business objectives relevant to your area, and align your work to those objectives and seek to deliver business value
- Proactively and continually, improve your level of knowledge about Amazon’s business and relevant data resources


A day in the life
Our Business Intelligence Engineer builds data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and analyses to deliver metrics and insights to the business.
Our Business Intelligence Engineers tackle some of the most complex challenges in large scale
computing, work in small teams across the company to contribute to the e-commerce platform that's used by millions of people all over the world. With that in mind, we require applicants to demonstrate their technical skills in a number of areas.


About the team
If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.

- Competitive salary
- Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
- Networking opportunities with fellow interns
- Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
- Mentorship and career development

If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies.


Internship length is 6 months.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.
Want to know more about our opportunities? Visit our EMEA Student Programs Team Events page to register for one of our upcoming events: https://amazonstudentevents.splashthat.com/careers

Basic qualifications

- Work 40 hours/week minimum and commit to 6 month internship maximum
- Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
- Experience in data querying or modeling with SQL, Excel
- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of one or more industry analytics visualization tools like Excel, Tableau, AWS QuickSight, MicroStrategy or PowerBI, and statistical methods like t-test or Chi-squared

title: Apprenti(e) Retail Vendor Manager FRA
descriptionHtml:
Un univers d’opportunités chez Amazon
Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle accélère, prend des tournants et vous met au défi d’une manière que vous n’auriez jamais imaginée. Dès votre arrivée, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : créer des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonnent la manière dont elles vivent, travaillent et interagissent au quotidien. C’est ici que vos idées se transforment en un véritable impact.
Vous travaillerez avec des outils de premier plan, des plateformes mondiales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à une échelle extraordinaire. Vous avancerez vite, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent vraiment. Grâce à d’innombrables opportunités à explorer au sein de différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez rapidement, mettrez en pratique vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences que vous ne soupçonniez pas. C’est un environnement pensé pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l’impact concret de leur travail dans le monde.
Prêt(e) à commencer votre aventure ? Une alternance chez Amazon, c’est de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour. Vous construirez, testerez et apprendrez aux côtés de personnes qui veulent vous voir réussir, tout en ayant un impact qui va bien au-delà du campus.

Key job responsibilities
Travailler à partir du client, en identifiant les leviers pour développer les marques les plus stratégiques d’Amazon et améliorer leur performance au sein d’une catégorie retail.
•      Accompagner les vendor managers dans la fourniture d’une gamme de services conçus pour aider les marques à réussir, en collaborant avec des équipes transversales, notamment les équipes en charge des stocks et du marketing.
•      Développer des compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes en collectant, analysant et interprétant des données pour améliorer la performance de la catégorie.
•      Comprendre les points de friction des clients, leurs besoins et la valeur potentielle à travers les activités retail, publicitaires et les services aux marchands.
•      Identifier les comptes cibles en utilisant des données de marché et des informations sectorielles pour soutenir la croissance de l’activité.
•      Identifier les opportunités d’amélioration des produits, services, processus, systèmes et outils à travers l’ensemble de l’entreprise.
•      Collaborer avec différentes parties de l’organisation Amazon pour mettre en œuvre des projets d’amélioration, incluant les équipes catégorie, les équipes produit et les équipes de support technique.


A day in the life
Une journée type
Chaque jour est un peu différent en tant qu’apprenti(e) Retail Vendor Manager. En travaillant aux côtés d’un vendor manager, vous apprendrez comment Amazon gère son activité de commerce en ligne à travers différentes catégories de produits — des livres à la mode, de l’électronique à l’alimentaire, et bien plus encore. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser les données de performance d’une catégorie et à identifier des opportunités de croissance pour des marques stratégiques, puis consacrer votre après-midi à collaborer avec les équipes marketing ou de gestion des stocks pour mettre en œuvre un projet d’amélioration visant à enrichir l’expérience d’achat des clients.
Amazon est une entreprise obsédée par le client : quelle que soit la catégorie retail que vous rejoignez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à travailler à partir des besoins du client pour identifier ce qui compte le plus. Vous serez exposé(e) aux produits publicitaires d’Amazon et aux services aux marchands, vous apprendrez comment nous créons des opportunités sur mesure pour satisfaire nos clients, et vous collaborerez avec différentes fonctions pour obtenir des résultats — développant ainsi vos compétences analytiques, commerciales et de résolution de problèmes dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution.

About the team
À propos de l’équipe
Communauté des alternants : En tant qu’alternant(e) Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et solidaire qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des alternants et stagiaires du monde entier, en tissant des liens et en participant à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des domaines tels que le développement durable, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.

title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

Students in the last years of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar.

About the Role

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site


Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NhMAOg79R2M

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers — in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them.

Basic qualifications

- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027/2028.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
- Our Data Centres are not served by public transport, so you will need your own means of getting to site
- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components

Preferred qualifications

- Basic knowledge of Linux and networking
- An interest in computer sciences and information technology

title: Senior Maintenance Technician, RME EMA4
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
- Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes
- Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
- Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
- Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
- Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardise processes across the EU network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or technical solutions, like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, preventative maintenance procedures, blueprint and schematic reading, industrial electrical, industrial controls, industrial electronics, Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programs, National Electrical Code (NEC), work order management

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechatronics or a related technical field
- Experience in vendor management
- Experience with robotic maintenance
- Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead
- Experience working with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards in accordance with OEM requirements

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, III, ADC2S Constellix
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building software systems that operate at massive scale and directly impact millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer III at Amazon, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of complex software solutions that span the full product lifecycle — from defining technical strategy to deployment and ongoing maintenance. In this role, you will tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems where the technology path forward is not yet defined, balancing competing constraints to deliver solutions that are performant, extensible, and secure. You will shape your team's architectural direction, mentor fellow engineers, and drive engineering best practices that raise the bar for quality across the organization. If you are a collaborative, creative engineer who thrives on solving hard problems and making systems simpler, we want to hear from you.


Our team provides the foundational services that every Amazon builder depends on to develop, deploy, and operate software from continuous deployment orchestration to testing infrastructure and configuration management. We ensure these services maintain parity, reliability, and security across all regions. Our team builds products and tools supporting the deployment experience and operations for Amazon Dedicated Clouds (ADCs) supporting U.S. Government agencies.


Developers at Amazon work on real world problems on a global scale, own their systems end-to-end, and influence the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions customers around the world. Join a team of super smart, customer obsessed developers that think big and have fun.


The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design and implementation of software systems consisting of multiple features, working across related teams to ensure solutions are well-architected, scalable, and maintainable.
- Own your team's technical direction by evaluating trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term architectural health, and by guiding future technology choices with context and clarity.
- Drive engineering best practices across the team, including code quality standards, operational excellence through alarms, telemetry, and runbooks, and effective retrospective processes.
- Mentor and develop engineers on your team and across the organization by providing technical guidance, career coaching, and constructive feedback that strengthens the broader engineering community.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners to work backwards from customer needs, identify the right problems to solve, and deliver incremental, high-quality software that creates measurable value.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing the latest operational metrics and addressing any alerts from overnight. Mid-morning, you join a design review where you help a teammate refine the architecture for a new feature, asking the right questions to uncover hidden dependencies. After lunch, you pair with an engineer to work through a tricky implementation challenge, then shift to writing a technical design document for an upcoming project. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on coding with guiding your team toward pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 5+ years of full stack development experience
- Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs

title: Sr. Tech CSM - Emerging Products, AWS Applied AI Solutions GTM
descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Are you passionate about transforming how enterprises manage their financial operations through the power of agentic AI? Do you envision a future where intelligent automation eliminates the friction in contract-to-cash workflows — connecting the dots across contract management, billing, invoicing, collections, and cash application that no single system holds today? Then come help us bring the next generation of AI-powered financial intelligence to market at AWS.

As a Technical Customer Solutions Manager, you will be a trusted advisor to the customer, working at the intersection of AI, enterprise finance systems, and real-world business operations. You will own the end-to-end execution of design-partner engagements — driving delivery toward agreed success criteria, co-leading technical discovery across the customer's finance systems landscape, and guiding implementation from early engagement through production. You will be the connective tissue between the customer and our internal teams: running governance and delivery cadences, surfacing the voice of the customer into product and engineering, and ensuring every engagement converts into measurable value and reference-able outcomes.


Key job responsibilities
- Engagement Execution & Governance: Own end-to-end execution of design-partner engagements — drive delivery plans, run governance and status cadences, manage risks and escalations, and ensure engagements progress toward agreed KPIs and value-realization milestones
- Technical Discovery & Implementation: Co-lead technical discovery across the customer's finance systems landscape — IT environment, integration paths, and data inventory — and guide implementation across ERP, CLM, and AR systems, articulating trade-offs and partnering with the Solutions Architect on solution design
- Value Realization & Business Case: Co-create success criteria and business-value framing with finance stakeholders, building the case that connects AI-driven contract-to-cash adoption to measurable outcomes such as reduced DSO, recovered revenue leakage, and faster dispute resolution
- Voice of the Customer: Capture, structure, and surface customer feedback into product and engineering — maintaining a disciplined feedback loop and partnering with Product to prioritize gaps that unblock customer value, without owning the roadmap itself
- Stakeholder Management & Communication: Build trusted relationships across technical and business stakeholders — from finance and IT practitioners to senior decision-makers — communicating clearly and driving alignment through a pre-GA environment where ambiguity is the norm

You will define transaction strategies where none exist, navigate ambiguity, and drive results that directly influence network capacity and long-term business goals. This role calls for someone who is resourceful, collaborative, and skilled at turning data into actionable recommendations — someone who thrives when partnering across teams to solve real problems with real consequences.
