title: Supply Chain Manager II, Amazon XL (AMXL) Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Extra Large Supply Chain organization built to manage every stage of the fulfillment process- inbound, capacity, linehaul, yard, and delivery - under a single leader. This is a rare chance to see and shape a complex, worldwide supply chain network that moves unique, large-format products with special handling requirements all the way to millions of customers.

As a Supply Chain Manager on our End-to-End team, you will own problems at the intersection of modeling and analytics and hands-on stakeholder engagement. You'll build the models that drive network decisions, then take them directly to the subject-matter experts who run transportation, fulfillment, delivery, and engineering — translating analysis into operational change in real time. This role is for someone who wants both: the quantitative depth of network planning and the influence of partnering with the people who move the freight.

You'll support inventory capacity and transportation management across our Fulfillment and Sortation Network — managing trailer timeliness, linehaul scheduling, and transportation execution. Scope will flex with the needs of the network and your strengths, but you can expect ownership of the metrics and programs that keep the network running efficiently.

Because we operation end-to-end from fulfillment through delivery, cross functional work is the daily default. You'll partner across Operations, Transportation, Finance, Product, and Engineering, and you'll be close enough to the operation to solve problems that have immediate, visible impact on our network and our customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own analytical models that drive transportation decisions across the Fulfillment and Sortation Network
- Translate analysis into operational change by partnering directly with transportation, fulfillment, delivery, and engineering subject-matter experts. This means you will go into facilities, see the package flow, understand the operation, and help drive the business with tactical and strategic support
- Manage trailer timeliness, linehaul scheduling, and transportation execution against network metrics and glidepaths
- Own capacity and transportation programs that keep the network running efficiently, adjusting scope as network priorities shift
- Identify operational inefficiencies and drive automation and scalable systems to resolve them
- Partner cross-functionally across Operations, Transportation, Finance, Product, and Engineering to solve problems in real time
- Communicate findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership to drive aligned decisions. This includes analytical results in Business Reviews, documents with decision gates, and ad-hoc support to fix critical operational challenges.

A day in the life
You start the morning in your models, monitoring overnight trailer timeliness and linehaul performance, updating an AI tool to monitor a regional issue. You then present your findings and recommendation in a business review to 7 senior leaders—and walk out with a decision made and a change live that same day. The afternoon turns strategic and cross-functional: you learn the network through its experts—a transportation SME on scheduling constraints, an engineer on yard design constraints, Finance on cost trade-offs. No two days match. Your decisions directly impact customers, ensuring they receive their products on-time and satisfied.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

The NA AMXL Supply Chain Science and Engineering team (SSE) leads the growth and profitability of our network. We calibrate capacity to demand, safeguard the health of our end-to-end supply chain, and make the structural changes that keep it ahead of the business. Operating as a closed-loop execution engine, we own both capacity health and the linehaul execution that feeds it—backed by real-time intelligence that lets us act proactively, not reactively. Over five years, AMXL has become arguably the world's best Heavy-Bulky provider. Come help us get better, every day!

title: Sr Program Manager, Workplace Health & Safety
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Workplace Health & Safety’s (WHS) mission is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and well being. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking a Sr. Program Manager for the WHS Central Programs Team (CPT) to lead safety projects from ideation through network deployment using the Project Bolster Framework. In this role, you will dive deep into operations processes; identify risks through data and first-hand experience; build programs and improve processes to eliminate risks; and influence operations to sustain a culture of safety.

This role requires you to operate effectively in ambiguous environments — structuring complex problem spaces, defining project scope and success criteria, and building clear narratives when inputs are incomplete. You will own end-to-end project delivery across multiple Business Units (BUs) and geographies, managing concurrent workstreams through Proof of Concept, Pilot, and Network Deployment phases. The role demands strong execution rigor: managing vendor relationships, purchase orders, site deployments, and cross-functional dependencies against tight timelines.

You will influence without authority — earning trust with cross-functional partners including Operations, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT), Amazon Robotics (AR), Engineering Services, Global Procurement (GPO), and WHS field teams to drive alignment and secure resources. You will communicate proactively through written narratives, tollgate reviews, and stakeholder updates — translating data into actionable insights for audiences ranging from site-level associates to senior leadership.

A critical dimension of this role is process improvement. You will identify inefficiencies, document lessons learned, create mechanisms that the broader team adopts, and contribute to the continuous refinement of CPT's project management standards. You will use FMEA, process maps, value stream maps, and decision matrices to surface risks and drive evidence-based decisions.

This position requires travel up to approximately 25%, when needed (and with appropriate health and safety conditions).

• Own full project lifecycle from ideation through network deployment, including tollgate preparation, narrative development, entitlement submission, and project closure

title: Sr. Planning & Ops Mgr, SIMS
descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will support the operational performance of independent sellers on the Amazon marketplace, helping them improve how they plan and send inventory into Amazon's fulfillment network. You will act as a key connection point between sellers, Amazon's fulfillment and supply chain operations, category teams, and product teams - working to protect both the seller and customer experience. You will drive system and process improvements in partnership with internal operations and seller-support teams, and deliver the operational programs that help make the Amazon India business efficient and scalable over the long term. You will create, write, and review business cases, conduct supporting research and analysis, and develop solutions from concept through execution and monitoring.

This role requires strong self-motivation, a bias for action, and sharp project management skills. The ideal candidate works closely with category leaders, supply chain teams, operations teams, and technology partners to develop strategy, automation, dashboards, and execution mechanisms that solve complex inbound operations problems. You will collaborate across cross-functional teams to improve seller operational performance alongside high-impact operations improvement programs

Key job responsibilities
-Ensure seller/vendor account performance is healthy and delivered in line with targets for inventory and inbound health, while balancing out operating plans
-Identify and articulate the strategic importance of metrics to manage tradeoffs, improve customer experience, and drive decisions with internal and external stakeholders
-Partner with vendor operations teams on strategies to reduce cost, lead time, and waste across the end-to-end supply chain

Your day is anchored around your sellers' performance. You begin by reviewing inbound and inventory health metrics, identifying any gaps in availability and diving deep to find root causes. You lead working sessions on the process improvements you own, and prepare recommendations for senior stakeholder forums. As the connective point across seller, operations, category, and product teams, you turn seller needs into coordinated action - balancing daily execution with the longer-term bets that make your sellers, and the business, stronger.

About the team
Our team manages seller accounts on the Amazon India marketplace, partnering with independent sellers to run their supply chain with the rigor and efficiency of the platform's most mature businesses. We sit at the intersection of sellers, fulfillment and supply chain operations, category teams, and product teams - ensuring inventory flows smoothly, availability stays strong, and the customer experience is protected. descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Robotics/AI Motor Control Scientist to develop cutting-edge machine learning algorithms for motor control systems in robots. In this role, you will focus on creating and optimizing intelligent motor control strategies to enable robots to perform complex, whole-body tasks. Your contributions will be essential in advancing robotics by enabling fluid, reliable, and safe interactions between robots and their environments.

Key job responsibilities

- Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams to integrate motor control systems with robotic hardware, ensuring alignment with real-world constraints such as actuator dynamics and energy efficiency

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is looking for a dynamic Commissioning Engineer. It is the responsibility of all Amazonians to have alignment with our leadership principles and demonstrate these at the highest level.

The responsibilities of the ACx Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi-discipline division of work related to design review and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure for new construction and special projects. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water, BMS, and EPMS systems. They shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to develop and review electrical and mechanical component and integrated systems testing along with other commissioning documents to ensure they are compliant with the basis of design, specification, industry standards and sequence of operations. It is the CxE responsibility to ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the appropriate safety practices and policies. CxE is responsible for auditing commissioning activities continuously to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. The CxE proactively communicates with the ACx Regional Manager and the ACx team to ensure that the applicable test documents are created and executed in accordance with all commissioning requirements. This individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects, lessons learned, and program improvements to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight schedules.

• Work at heights and from ladders
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl

• Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
• Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
• Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
• Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS PrivateLink
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion

AWS PrivateLink carries private connectivity for roughly 200+ AWS services and third-party providers, without traffic crossing the public internet. For many customers it sits on their critical availability path, and for those whose policies prohibit public egress it is the only route.

We are hiring a Senior SDE to build the next generation of PrivateLink: a control plane engineered for 20x our current tens of thousands of TPS, a data plane to match, and the product vision behind both.

The goal is private connectivity that keeps pace with AI. Inference platforms, agentic systems, and ML pipelines now provision and reconcile connectivity continuously, at machine speed, and move far more data over it. The limits in our way are structural, not numbers we can raise. The read path, the tenant isolation model, the provisioning architecture, and how bandwidth scales with demand are all open decisions, and you will make several of them.

We have built real agentic tooling for migration, test generation, and operational analysis. You will use it and extend it.

Key job responsibilities
* Shape the product vision for private connectivity in AI-native environments, working directly with AWS service teams and large external partners on what they need from us next.
* Own the architecture and delivery of core components of the next generation of PrivateLink, across both the control plane and the data plane, targeting 20x current scale.
* Make the foundational design decisions that are still open, and bring AWS service teams and senior engineers along with them.
* Build for multi-tenant isolation and fairness, and scale capacity with demand rather than manual intervention, so one customer's growth never becomes another customer's latency.
* Execute against live production traffic with no maintenance window, operate what you build, and extend the team's agentic tooling for migration, test generation, and operational analysis.

About the team
The AWS PrivateLink team builds and operates the technology that enables customers to securely access AWS services, third-party applications, and their own services over the Amazon VPC network—without exposing traffic to the public internet. As a Sr. SDE on this team, you'll design and scale highly available, low-latency networking infrastructure that powers private connectivity for millions of endpoints worldwide. You'll tackle complex distributed systems challenges, drive architectural decisions, and mentor engineers—all while helping customers simplify their network security posture at cloud scale.

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

title: Safety Risk Engineer, WHS Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.
- Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.
- Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.

A day in the life
You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. A large part of your day is influencing — helping functional leaders understand machinery risk and building buy-in to the Health & Safety standards and changes you recommend.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial engineering.
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (B2/C1), both written and verbal.
- Experience conducting machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites, applying the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC).
- Experience engaging and influencing functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

title: Controls Design Engineer (EPMS), CDE
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Data Center Global Services team is looking for an exceptional individual to contribute to the Controls & Technology organization by joining the Controls Design Engineering team (CDE). The CDE primary responsibility is to track, document, communicate and enhance global data center design standards with a focus on control, automation and electrical power monitoring systems.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need talented, bright, and driven people. This is your chance to make history by joining a company whose potential has no limits.

The ideal candidate will need a wide-ranging background in data center environmental controls systems, IT infrastructure, networking, mechanical facility operations, electrical power monitoring, project management and strong leadership skills.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act with a global perspective and have the ability to contribute to sophisticated innovations in the area of building controls and automation initiatives, this is the challenge you are looking for!

Controls Design Engineering (CDE)

The CDE team provides Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) design coordination globally.


The team’s goal is to deliver consistent standards for data center controls systems, as well as overall mechanical and electrical design practices. Due to the critical nature and complexity of designing, installing, and maintaining a BMS/EPMS, the CDE team is the primary owner of the associated specification, points list, Basis of Design and scope documents within a large infrastructure engineering team.


The CDE team is a single point of contact for multiple internal and external customers, uniting the efforts associated with:
- New construction builds
- Legacy site enhancement projects
- Data center service projects

In a continual effort to enhance the controls systems, the CDE team collaborates through design review, drives consistent standards, and collects feedback data to arrive at unified documented solutions. Due to the efforts of maintaining, updating, and distributing BMS/EPMS standards, the CDE engineer will drive significant reductions in change order expense, scope gaps between contractors, construction schedule delays, single-sourced vendor pricing, and reduced vendor project management and engineering labor costs.



Key job responsibilities

This position is for an EPMS Controls Design Engineer. Key responsibilities and requirements for this role include:
- Knowledge of EPMS programming and design, Modbus communication protocol, electrical distribution systems, single-line diagrams, complex electrical concepts, and data center redundancy
- Review MEP drawings with a focus on electrical drawing sets for EPMS design content
- Create EPMS scopes of work (SOW), provide RFI support, and review technical vendor proposals during bid review process
- Coordinate with each regional project manager to review and finalize project SOWs
- Review electrical Long Lead Equipment (LLE) submittals to ensure EPMS scope is captured
- Attend Factory Witness Tests (FWTs) and Equipment Qualification Tests (EQTs) to perform EPMS point validation and test EPMS device functionality on first of kind electrical equipment
- Create, update, and maintain controls points list and specifications, EPMS drawing templates, Basis of Design (BOD) documentation, and project specific SOW documents
- Develop and disseminate specification documents for global projects
- Lead and facilitate collaboration with multiple teams including construction, programmers, MEP/ACS engineers, and team managers as necessary to accomplish initiative goals
- Manage and prioritize requests for information on new construction builds, existing site facilities support, and legacy site enhancement projects
- Serve as central point of contact for multiple internal and external groups regarding EPMS design standards
- Ability to successfully operate in high security critical environments while maximizing productivity.
- Drive innovation of new solutions to support initiatives, team, and company goals
- Interaction with AWS cloud services and other applications to present, archive and analyze accumulated data
- Anticipate roadblocks and risks while providing escalation management
- Travel globally as needed to manage and support project initiatives

A day in the life
As a Controls Design Engineer, you'll focus on electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) design coordination across our global data center portfolio. Your day might include reviewing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) drawings to ensure EPMS design requirements are captured, collaborating with regional project managers to refine project scopes, or attending factory and equipment qualification tests to validate monitoring device functionality. As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you will define the technical architecture and build systems that manage mission-critical networks with high availability and low operational overhead. descriptionHtml:
AWS is building one of the largest energy portfolios in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa — and we need someone who can connect the dots across a complex, multi-country programme. As a Grid Analyst, you will drive programme visibility and business analytics for the energy infrastructure that powers AWS data centres across EMEA.

This is not a desk-bound reporting role. You will own the programme rhythm — aggregating data from multiple workstreams, building dashboards that surface risks early, and ensuring leadership has a clear, single view of cost, schedule, and capacity across the portfolio. descriptionHtml:
How often have you had an opportunity to be at ground zero of a disruptive, fast-growing, and revolutionary global Amazon service? How frequently do you get to start from the foundation and solve customer needs at a global scale in a fast-growing entertainment streaming industry? At Prime Video, we are pioneering a new generation of digital supply chain at a remarkable speed to accelerate our market position and global reach. If this sounds interesting, come build the future of streaming entertainment with us!

Prime Video is a global premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic and global environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. The Partner Operations Management (POM) team is looking for a bright, partner-obsessed, driven, and creative individual to join our team in India. POM is responsible for driving a world-class partner experience through enabling partners to deliver assets of all varieties on-time, in full and at the Prime Video quality bar.

As a Sr. Partner Operations Manager, you will serve as the primary relationship owner for our third-party studios, content distributors, and fulfillment vendors (collectively "partners") in India. You will build and nurture long-term, strategic partnerships — engaging studio executives to influence their supply chain investments, delivery workflows, and feature adoption strategies. You will be the voice of the partner within Prime Video, capturing partner-specific insights and regional nuance to ensure our partners succeed and our customers benefit.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end partner experience — from driving timely and cost-effective delivery of source materials to identifying improvement opportunities through reporting, data analysis, and innovative workflow enhancements. You will conduct regular partner business reviews, manage complex escalations, and tailor strategies to individual partner contexts across India's diverse content landscape (including SVOD, AVOD, TVOD,Channels, and partner direct business lines). The ability to develop, own, and report on key performance metrics is critical.
This role will work with executive-level leadership within the streaming community. Internal teams include content acquisition, marketing, engineering, content processing, legal, finance, and accounting teams. External teams vary based on partner and may include marketing, rights management, IT, engineering, localization, compliance, and digital operations teams.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned studio partners in India, building trusted executive-level relationships that influence partner investments in delivery capabilities and content quality
• Conduct trend analysis and deep dives on partner performance against KPI targets to drive perfect delivery to Prime Video
• Act as the voice of the partner — capturing partner-specific feedback, regional nuances, and operational realities to advocate for solutions that enable partner success
• Own and lead regular partner business reviews (WBRs,MBRs, QBRs), translating performance data into actionable strategies tailored to each partner's context
• Manage complex escalations that may span across multiple business units, driving resolution while maintaining strong partner relationships
• Distill insights on partner capabilities to advise and enhance business strategies such as new content and market launches in India
• Drive partner adoption of delivery best practices and new platform capabilities by tailoring strategies to individual partner needs and technical maturity
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, product development, and cost reduction through data analysis and direct partner engagement
• Drive long-term solutions through next-gen automation and AI innovations to complex workflows
• Mentor team members and help develop talent across the organization


A day in the life
• Engage directly with studio partner executives to understand their priorities, address delivery challenges, and align on strategic goals
• Lead partner performance reviews, using data-driven insights combined with partner context to identify root causes and drive improvements
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure partner feedback is heard and acted upon, influencing how Prime Video builds and evolves its tools and features
• Design workflow strategies for accelerated content delivery in multiple languages and formats across India's diverse content ecosystem, while simplifying and eliminating redundant practices
• Streamline business and technology solutions that strengthen our partnerships while advancing our services
• Work effectively in a team environment and cross-functionally with Prime Video Catalog technology teams, engineers, business teams, analytics, and product

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time

title: Clearable DCEO Facility Manager, LCK InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Facility Manager to serve as a technical resource and leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. The Data Center Facility Manager is responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the data center. The Data Center Facility Manager will assist in maintaining a high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

This is a clearable position. The selected candidate must be a US citizen and will be required to successfully obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical physical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Coordinates daily with a multitude of third party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs
- Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures
- Routinely operate as the afterhours on-call Data Center Facility Manager for the data centers in the region. This will include responding to any issues within the data centers and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s).

Physical Requirements:
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain.
- Work at heights and from ladders.

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.
- Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration.
- Respond to off hour emergency calls.
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

-3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
-2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
-Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

-3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
-Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapid growth of AWS business and customers 24x7. We commit to maintain the critical facility infrastructure of AWS and ensure the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency and cost. The DCEO Team is seeking individuals who are motivated, self-starters, eager to learn, passionate and committed to join us. As part of the Infrastructure Operations Team, you will have the chance to work on the most advanced technologies in a dynamic environment. If you enjoy working in a strong, close-knit and diverse team, Infrastructure Operations Team is the place to be!


Key job responsibilities
- Rotating shift work is required to maintain 24/7 operations coverage
- Monitor and operate electrical and mechanical equipment in the data center.
- Perform routine rounds and record daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment (e.g. temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.).
- Respond to emergencies, perform troubleshooting to resolve facility equipment issues, participate in emergency drills and on-call rotation, and report to site as required in support of facility emergency response per established protocols.
- Arrange and supervise contractors and vendors to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment, and verify that the quality of work meets internal standards and requirements
- Provide guidance and training to junior technicians and new joiners
- Assist in develop, review and update the MOP/SOP to ensure compliance with internal standards

- 需輪班工作以維持24/7的運作。
- 監控及操作數據中心內的電氣與機械設備
- 進行每日例行巡檢，記錄所有機械及電氣設備的運行數據（如溫度、電壓、電流等）
- 響應緊急事件，進行故障排除以解決設施設備問題，參與緊急演習及待命輪值，並按既定程序及需要到場支援設施緊急應變
- 安排及監督承辦商和供應商，確保所有設施設備的正常運作及維護，並核實工作質量符合內部標準及要求
- 為初級技術員及新入職員工提供指導及培訓
- 協助制定、審查及更新工作程序／標準操作程序，以確保符合內部標準。


A day in the life
Also expected from the EOT is the ability to execute small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve moderate amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in controlled environments. The EOT will be tasked with creating and delivering key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results. The goals of such projects are to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- A Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline is typically required.
- 5+ years of electrical or mechanical practical and technical experience
- A valid Registered Electrical Worker (REW) Certificate, Grade A or above
- A valid Construction Industry Safety Training Certificate (Green Card) and a Construction Workers Registration Card are required.
- Work on a rotating shift to maintain 24/7 operations coverage.
- Able to independently operate, troubleshoot, and maintain electrical and mechanical systems, and interpret technical documents and drawings.
- Demonstrated experience in utilizing BMS and EPMS control systems
- Basic proficiency in computer applications, including Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Word, Excel, Outlook)
- 具備電氣/機械/屋宇設備工程或相關學科的文憑
- 5年或以上機電或冷氣系統及樓宇設備相關之經驗
- 持有機電署註冊電業工程人員牌照(A0或以上)
- 持有效建造業安全訓練證書（綠卡）及建造業工人註冊證
- 需輪班工作以維持24/7的運作
- 能獨立操作、排除故障及維護電氣與機械系統，並能閱讀及理解技術文件與圖則
- 具備使用樓宇管理系統（BMS）及電力監控系統（EPMS）的實際經驗
- 具備基本電腦操作能力，包括 Microsoft Office（Word、Excel、Outlook)

Preferred qualifications

- Higher Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline
- 2+ years of experience in Data Center operation & maintenance
- A valid Registered Electrical Worker (REW) Certificate, Grade B or above
- 具備電氣、機械、屋宇設備工程或相關學科的高級文憑或學士學位
- 2年或以上數據中心運營及維護經驗
- 持有機電署註冊電業工程人員牌照(B0或以上)

title: Program Manager, Non-UDS Service Program (AMXL), Program Manager, Non-UDS Service Program (AMXL)
descriptionHtml:
エアコン・水回り・ドライブレコーダー…「届けるだけ」では終わらない、設置まで責任を持つ新しい配送体験を一緒につくりませんか？
アマゾンジャパンでは、専門施工業者（Service Provider）と連携して商品の設置・組み立てを提供する「non-UDS（Non-Unified Delivery Services）」プログラムのプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。エアコン工事、水栓設置、スマートロック、ドライブレコーダー取り付け、壁掛けテレビなど、Customerが自分では難しい施工を、購入と同時にシームレスに予約・完了できる体験を作ることが私たちのミッションです。
本ポジションは Amazon Logistics Extra Large Team（AMXL）に所属し、専門施工業者との関係構築・運営管理、サービスカテゴリの拡張、そして Customerエクスペリエンスの継続的な改善をリードします。
本ポジションの所属部門等に関する詳細は、下記リンク先をご参照ください。 ■部門紹介：Last Mile (AMZL) / Extra Large (AMXL) ■職種紹介：Project / Program Management
※Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazon は男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。
Amazon では、最新の AI Tool・生成 AI を日々の業務に積極的に取り入れています。意思決定のスピードを加速させ、本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中できる環境を提供しています。


﻿
Would you like to build a service experience that goes beyond delivery — one that takes responsibility all the way through installation?
Amazon Japan is hiring a Program Manager for its non-UDS (Non-Unified Delivery Services) program, which partners with professional Service Providers (SPs) to offer installation and assembly services — air conditioners, faucets, smart locks, dashcams, wall-mount TVs, and more — seamlessly bundled with product purchase.
This role sits within the Amazon Logistics Extra Large Team (AMXL) and leads SP relationship management, service category expansion, and continuous Customer experience improvement.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities / 主な職務内容
プログラムマネージャーとして、専門施工業者（SP）との関係を軸に、以下の業務全般をリードします。

施工業者の管理・立ち上げ
・新規施工業者の発掘・コスト交渉・契約締結
・既存施工業者の週次パフォーマンスレビューと改善指示（最速予約可能日・日程変更率・初回完工率などを管理）
・施工業者・社内サポート窓口からの問い合わせ対応・解決
・施工業者への月次支払い処理（将来的な自動化の推進を含む）

サービスカテゴリの管理
・エアコン・水回り・スマートロック・ドライブレコーダー等のサービス設定・価格設定・サービス紹介ページ作成
・取り付けサービスを提供する対象商品の管理（追加・削除）
・サービス選択フローの設計・最適化による現地での追加料金発生の削減
・新カテゴリのローンチロードマップ策定と実行

日常オペレーションの管理
・施工業者のサービス提供エリア・稼働枠の設定サポート
・試験稼働の実施・段階的ローンチ計画の立案
・カスタマーサービス・社内サポート向け作業マニュアルの作成・改訂

カスタマーエクスペリエンスの改善
・Customerレビュー・問い合わせデータの分析と改善策立案
・AIを活用したサービス選択フローの精度向上（2027年計画）
・サービス品質指標（初回完工率・日程変更率・Customerレビュー）のモニタリング

﻿-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
As a Program Manager, you will lead the following across partner management, service operations, and Customer experience.
・Build and manage relationships with professional installation partners across categories including air conditioning, plumbing, smart locks, dashcams, and TV mounting
・Lead weekly partner performance reviews, track key metrics (earliest appointment availability, rescheduling rate, first-visit completion rate), and drive improvement actions
・Own partner onboarding end-to-end: recruiting, cost negotiation, contract execution, and setup of service area and capacity management
・Manage service configuration, service page creation, and service option flow design to reduce unexpected on-site charges
・Handle partner and support team inquiry escalations; coordinate resolutions across Customer Service and product planning teams
・Create and revise operational manuals for Customer Service and support teams
・Drive service category expansion roadmap; manage phased launches with trial operations
・Analyze Customer review data and develop experience improvement plans (including 2027 AI-assisted service scoping initiative)

A day in the life
朝は前日のパフォーマンスデータの確認から始まります。日程変更率が上昇している施工業者があればすぐに原因を特定し、対応を調整します。

午前中は施工業者との週次定例で、稼働不足の解消策と新エリアの拡大計画を議論します。昼過ぎは商品企画チームと新カテゴリ（例：ガス周り施工）のローンチに向けたサービス選択フローの設計を検討。夕方は社内サポート窓口からエスカレーションされたサービス表示のトラブルを調査し、翌日の作業マニュアル更新につなげます。単なる「問題対応」ではなく、「次回は現場で自己解決できる仕組みを作る」という視点で動き続けます。

Each day starts with a review of previous-day performance data. If rescheduling rates are spiking for a particular partner, you quickly identify root causes and coordinate fixes. Morning brings a weekly sync with a partner to discuss staffing shortfalls and new area expansion.
In the afternoon, you work with the product planning team on service option flow design for a new category launch. In the evening, you investigate a service display issue escalated from the support team, then update the operational manual. The mindset is never just "fix the issue" — it's always "build the system so the field can solve it next time."

About the team
我々は施工業者・Amazon・Customerの三者全員にとって「良い仕組み」を作ることに情熱を持つチームです。オペレーションとビジネスの境界を越えて動くことを楽しめる人を求めています。経験よりも「なぜそうなっているのか」を問い続ける姿勢と、現場・データ・関係者の声を束ねて前進できる実行力を重視します。
施工業者との信頼関係の構築、商品企画チームとの戦略議論——多様な関係者と対等に向き合いながら、日本の施工サービス体験を変えていく仕事です。

We are a team passionate about building systems that work well for installation partners, Amazon, and Customers alike. We value people who enjoy moving across the boundaries of operations and business — those who keep asking "why does it work this way?" and who can synthesize the voices of the field, data, and stakeholders into forward momentum.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability, and scaling) new and existing systems. Experience programming with at least one software programming language: Java, Python, or TypeScript. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU Member state.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and operating scalable, high-availability production systems, and owning their operational excellence. Experience developing with SQL and NoSQL databases, and with cloud technologies (AWS). Experience quickly prototyping new systems and solutions. Familiarity with security automation, threat detection, or incident response tooling (a plus, not required). Excellent written and oral communication skills. Meets/exceeds Amazon's leadership principles requirements for this role. Meets/exceeds Amazon's functional/technical depth and complexity for this role.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

title: Security Incident Response, Security Engineer, US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Security Incident Response Analyst to detect, investigate, and respond to threats against a U.S. Government program building a purpose-built, classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with protecting customer trust, and on a fully air-gapped platform with no commercial cloud control plane we build our detection and response capability from the ground up. In this role you monitor security telemetry, triage and investigate alerts, drive incidents through containment, eradication, and recovery, and turn every event into better detections and playbooks. You will work in the trenches with detection engineers, SOC analysts, forensics, and our Government counterparts to keep a high-value classified system defensible around the clock. If you like being the person who runs toward the alarm and closes the loop, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Monitor security telemetry and triage, investigate, and escalate alerts on the disconnected platform.
• Drive incidents through the full response lifecycle: containment, eradication, recovery, and after-action.
• Develop and tune detection content and response playbooks from incident learnings.
• Coordinate incident reporting and handoffs with the ISSM and Government counterparts.

A day in the life
Your shift starts with a sweep of overnight security telemetry on the air-gapped platform. You triage queued alerts, separating noise from genuine threats, then dive deep into a suspicious authentication pattern. As you investigate, you drive it through containment and eradication, coordinating the response with your ISSM and Government counterparts. Midday, you huddle with detection engineers and SOC analysts to tune the alert logic that flagged it, turning today's incident into tomorrow's playbook. By afternoon, you document after-action findings and hand off cleanly to the next analyst. You run toward the alarm, close the loop, and keep a classified AI Factory defensible around the clock.

Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional) or CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) or CFR (CyberSec First Responder) or Cloud+ or CySA+ (CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst) or GCED (GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender) or GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional) or PenTest+
- Experience triaging and developing security alerts and response automation, conducting front-line analysis, and providing escalation support
- Knowledge of fundamentals of networking, security, databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
- 3+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non-internship) experience
- 3+ years of incident response, SOC, or security operations experience.
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler) or GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials) or Security+, or CISSP, CISA, CISM or other security certification
- Experience in confidential environments
- Familiarity with U.S. Government or IC incident-reporting requirements.

title: Launch Program Manager II, Global Engineering Services (GES) Launch
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, the Global Engineering Services Launch Team needs talented, bright, innovative and driven leaders. The key to this mission is strategic, large scale project management initiatives that will allow us to scale our organization for the future in an extraordinary manner. The Launch team is seeking a qualified candidate to solve the complex challenges of progressive innovation to drive efficiencies at operational benchmark rates. We are looking for a customer-obsessed Program Manager with proven program management experience and a strong track record of delivering results to own and execute highly strategic launches, in addition to driving multiple complex projects across one or more programs. If you are looking for an environment where you can drive business innovation amidst various levels of ambiguity, this is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing team within Amazon!

As a Launch Program Manager, you will work with and influence numerous cross-functional stakeholders both inside and outside of Global Engineering Services (GES) with a direct impact to our internal customers in operations. This role calls for an individual who is proficient in continuous improvement and is experienced in strategically developing processes and mechanisms to achieve business goals.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Robotics Senior Financial Analyst, Amazon Robotics Finance
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Robotics Finance team supporting the OIS (Operations Infrastructure Solutions) business is seeking a Financial Analyst II to support financial planning, controllership, and reporting across a $180MM OPEX and $524MM CAPEX portfolio for one of Amazon's most strategically complex infrastructure that support WW Fulfilment network, Amazon Robotics program, device, and automation programs.
This is a high-visibility, blended FP&A and Finance partnering role team that partners directly with senior Operations and Finance leadership. You will own the execution of core financial workflows while contributing to strategic work including capital planning, cost-to-serve analysis, and monthly financial reviews. The ideal candidate is analytically sharp, operationally disciplined, and comfortable operating in ambiguity within a fast-paced infrastructure finance environment.


Key job responsibilities
This is a blended FP&A and Finance partnering role. You will own recurring analytical and controllership workflows while serving as a proactive financial thought partner to OIS business and program leaders.
- Opportunity Program Management: Own monthly reporting and tracking across OIS programs (upwards of $100MM annually)
- Monthly Financial Review (MFR): Support month-end close and narrative preparation for OIS OPEX; maintain the Page 0 summary workbook, validate actuals vs. plan, and provide variance commentary
- Capital Approval Review (CAR): Support the capital request workflow; validate spend type classification (CAPEX vs. OPEX), budget alignment, and financial documentation quality
- Headcount & OPEX Planning: Maintain headcount roster and HC plan vs. actuals tracking; support OP1/OP2 and guidance cycle with OPEX scenario modeling and cost center analysis
- Finance Partnering: Act as a day-to-day financial thought partner to OIS vertical leads (Network, Device, Automation, Infrastructure Reliability); translate operational activity into financial performance narratives and support QBR for leadership review materials
- Financial Modeling & Automation: Build and maintain financial models and automated reporting tools
- Controllership: Execute SOP-98 capitalization tracking, GRC control reviews, and open PO accrual analysis; ensure financial data integrity across reporting cycles


A day in the life
Your day begins with reviewing opportunity submissions, flagging delinquencies, and maintaining the Page 0 operating expenses workbook. You draft variance commentary for the Monthly Financial Review and coordinate capital approvals with program owners. As close approaches, the tempo sharpens — you run the SOP-98 credit reconciliation, validate headcount actuals against plan, and assemble the MFR narrative package for leadership. Between cycles, you pursue process automation opportunities, leveraging AI tools embedded in the team's workflows to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy at scale.

About the team
The Amazon Robotics Finance team supporting the OIS business is a high-impact team managing financial oversight of programs across five verticals: OpsTech Network, Device Technologies, Continuous Infrastructure Automation, Infrastructure Reliability, and Customer Experience Infrastructure. The team uses AI-enabled tooling to manage reporting at scale and partners directly with senior Finance and Operations leadership. This role offers exceptional breadth across capital planning, entitlement reporting, controllership, and strategic cost analysis, with direct exposure to senior Finance leadership in a high-growth infrastructure organization.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 3+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

descriptionHtml:
We're on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. We are looking for an Inventory Planner to join our team in Brazil, supporting the management, consolidation, and analysis of large volumes of data and KPIs related to the company's warehouses. This role combines a strong analytical mindset with cross-functional collaboration, driving data-informed decisions that directly impact inventory operations, liquidation processes, and overall warehouse performance.
In this position, you will operate across two core strategic fronts that work in tandem to optimize our inventory network. First, you will lead the recovery of unsellable and slow-moving inventory through vendor returns and donation programs, identifying items that can be salvaged through these channels and managing their operational flow to accelerate exit from warehouses, reducing occupancy pressure and maximizing value recovery. Simultaneously, you will drive the forecasting and transfer of unsellable items across the fulfillment network, ensuring proper routing to warehouses and rapid inventory circulation while maintaining healthy occupancy levels through strategic placement decisions that support both operational efficiency and financial performance. Critical to both fronts is your ability to manage stakeholders effectively, coordinating with multiple teams across the supply chain organization to ensure alignment on priorities, drive execution, and maintain the operational momentum necessary for these programs to succeed.
At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about data and thrive in dynamic environments. You will play a key role in generating reports, building documentation, and providing actionable insights to support strategic forums and decision-making across the supply chain organization. If you are detail-oriented, love digging into data, enjoy partnering with diverse teams to solve complex problems, and are energized by managing multiple operational fronts simultaneously, this is the role for you.
