Manage, consolidate, and analyze large volumes of data and KPIs related to the company's warehouses, generating actionable insights for leadership forums and strategic decision-making.

title: Compliance Manager, Dangerous Goods, Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.

The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility, Chemical Safety Compliance and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

A Manager in GSRC team typically manages a team of up to 20 people. The role can also require managing a team of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and Individual Contributor (IC) that acts as support function for teams. Candidate will also be expected to interact with counterparts in other geographies and share best practices across the program and cross program. - Own business metrics and processes, aligned with business goals; Implement KPIs(Key Performance Indicators), metrics, audit processes, and best practices to track, maintain and exceed productivity (TPH) and quality (DPMO/defects/internal audit scores) as per service level agreements. title: Product Designer, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Observability is being rewritten. For a decade the job was to watch servers, services, and dashboards — metrics, logs, and traces for systems that did what they were told. That world is ending. The systems people now have to understand reason, call tools, and act on their own, and they generate signal at a scale and unpredictability the old tooling was never built for. When something breaks at 2am, the question is no longer only "which host is down" — it's "what did the system decide, why, and what did it touch."

AWS CloudWatch is where that gets solved at scale, for hundreds of thousands of engineers. You'll focus on two of the places that future is being built: Omni, a blank-canvas, IDE-style way to explore and query telemetry, and the DevOps agent — an AI agent that helps engineers investigate and resolve issues with a human in the loop. Your work will shape how engineers actually move through these experiences: what they see first, how they navigate, and how a problem goes from signal to cause to fix.

We're looking for a Product Designer who's hungry to do excellent craft on genuinely hard problems. You won't be handed pixel-perfect specs to execute — you'll own features end to end, partner closely with PM and engineering, and grow your scope as you show you can carry it. You'll have senior designers around you to learn from and a domain where the right answers aren't settled yet.

If you want to sharpen your craft on one of the most consequential problems in cloud — alongside people who treat CX as the thing that wins, not the thing you add at the end — this is a great place to do it.


Key job responsibilities
1. Own the design of features within Omni and the DevOps agent experience — from early exploration and IA through interaction, visual craft, and ship — with guidance from senior designers and your manager.
2. Make complex system behavior legible: turn high-cardinality, fast-moving telemetry and agent activity into views an engineer can actually reason about.
3. Design for the agentic shift — experiences where an AI agent helps engineers investigate and resolve issues, and where the human stays firmly in control (what the agent found, what it proposes, and how a person approves or redirects it).
4. Partner day to day with PM and engineering, contributing to problem definition — not just executing handed-off specs — and iterating quickly from their input.
5. Build prototypes that communicate intent precisely and move conversations forward.
6. Fold in evidence — usability testing, customer sessions, and telemetry — and let what you learn change the design.
7. Contribute to the shared design system: use and extend patterns rather than inventing one-off screens.

A day in the life
Morning. You pick up the feature you're closest to — say, how the Omni/DevOps agent surfaces what it found while triaging an incident, and how an engineer approves or redirects the next step. You've got a flow in progress and a couple of questions from yesterday's sync. You take a focused block to push the interaction model before the day fills up.

Midday. A working session with your PM and an engineer. You walk through your latest cut, hear what's technically cheap versus expensive, and leave with a sharper direction. You're part of the problem-definition conversation, not waiting at the end of it.

Afternoon. You sit in on a customer usability session and watch someone get stuck exactly where you worried they might. You bring the flow to design critique, get it pressure-tested by the broader team, and give feedback on someone else's work too. You end the day updating your prototype with what you learned.

The throughline. You're close to real customer problems, you're growing your scope with real support around you, and the work you do shows up in the product in weeks, not quarters.

About the team
We're the design team behind the broader AWS Security, Search, Observability & Governance organization. Our mandate is to make the most technical, highest-stakes workflows in cloud feel clear, fast, and even good to use.

What's distinctive about us:

- Design is the competitive advantage here. We're betting that in a market still figuring out what observability for the AI era even looks like, the team with the clearest experience wins — and we back that with real scope for designers at every level.
- We ship, and we ship hard things. Omni, the DevOps agent, core monitoring at massive scale — these are launching now, to real customers, against real competitors. Your work isn't theoretical.
- We work from evidence. Usability labs, customer sessions, and telemetry are part of the rhythm, not an afterthought.
- It's a place to grow. The designers around you have deep backgrounds in AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise platforms. You'll be challenged, well-supported, and surrounded by people worth learning from.

If you want to do excellent work in observability for the AI era — and grow fast while you're at it — come build it with us.

- Experience in design
- Experience in delivering design solutions as a UX designer or interaction designer
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience prototyping (HTML, XHTML, JavaScript, CSS, Flash or Flash Catalyst, or Axure)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in mass-market consumer web / mobile products
- Experience working in a collaborative team and working directly with developers for implementation of designs

title: Quality Assurance Engineer II, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

Amazon Leo is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to build and own the quality foundation for the software stack that powers in-flight connectivity for commercial airlines. The quality standards, test strategies, automation frameworks, and QMS (quality management system) processes will govern how software is developed and tested across a growing fleet and multiple airline customers for the life of the program.

The in flight connectivity solution operates at the intersection of embedded software, satellite connectivity, and real-time networking. Quality is not a gate at the end of this development process; it is built into every sprint, every interface contract, and every integration milestone from day one.

This role is as much about process creation as it is about test execution. You will define how the team approaches quality management system (QMS) compliance, establish traceability from requirements through test to certification evidence, and serve as the quality voice in every engineering and program decision.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
-Establish the Quality Management System (QMS) framework - define and document the quality processes, standards, and workflows that the engineering team must follow from initial development through aviation certification and production release. This includes software quality assurance (SQA) planning, process compliance checklists, deviation and nonconformance tracking, and quality metrics reporting to program leadership and airline customers.
-Own the test strategy for the customer solutions we build covering unit, integration, system, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test levels.
-Build and execute integration test plans for all program milestones
-Establish requirements traceability - build and maintain the bidirectional traceability matrix linking software requirements through design decisions through test cases through test results.
-Define and enforce performance requirements testing. Partner with engineering teams to define measurable acceptance criteria and build the test infrastructure to validate them against defined targets.
-Build test automation for the CI/CD pipeline.
-Drive design for testability across the engineering team - participate in architecture reviews, interface design reviews, and code reviews with an explicit focus on testability. Identify components or interfaces that cannot be adequately tested and drive design changes before implementation begins.
-Establish defect management process and quality reporting - define the defect lifecycle (discovery through triage through root cause through fix through regression), severity classifications aligned with aviation safety considerations, escalation thresholds, and the quality dashboards that program leadership uses to make release decisions.
-Champion quality culture - serve as the team's quality advocate in every program decision. Ensure that schedule pressure does not bypass quality gates, that certification evidence is generated alongside development rather than reconstructed after the fact, and that the team understands what aviation-grade quality means in practice.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a design review, where you assess the testability of an upcoming feature and outline your test approach. By midday, you are writing automated test scripts, validating complex workflows, and triaging newly reported defects to pinpoint root causes. Afternoons often involve collaborating with developers on bug fixes, refining test coverage based on code changes, and mentoring a teammate on automation best practices. You regularly contribute to retrospectives, sharing insights that help your team ship higher quality software faster.

About the team
Our team brings together engineers from avionics and embedded systems, enterprise networking, distributed cloud infrastructure, and aviation certification. Our team includes engineers with backgrounds ranging from embedded software to large-scale distributed systems - and we value the full range of that experience.
We are continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. You will find extensive knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded technical leader.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
- Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
- Experience of using test case management tools (e.g. Test Rail, TestLink) and issue management tools (Jira)

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Experience developing test strategies and plans for complex hardware/software systems or systems of systems
- Experience with requirements traceability tools and methodologies - building and maintaining bidirectional traceability matrices from requirements through test cases to test results, in a context where traceability is reviewed by external regulatory or customer auditors

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer, HYD-Infinity - DCEO
descriptionHtml:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is expanding the Data Center management team in India. This position serves as the primary operational resource to support ADSIPL within its owned and operated Data Centers in India. This position will provide a central point of ownership and accountability for the overall ‘hands-on’ management of the Mechanical, Electrical (M&E) and across ADSIPL’s portfolio of Data Centers in India. This position will be responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations within the Indian Data Center space. It will also include event management, incident management, problem management, change management, and cost/contract management. In addition, this will include the relationship management with the landlords, critical facility vendors, Data Center Construction team, Data Center Operations team, Technical Program Managers, Security team, and Logistics team in India. The position will require 24x7 on-call, scheduled weekend work support and rotational shift. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.

Key job responsibilities
Following are the primary responsibilities (but not limited to) of Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer:

Operations and Maintenance:
· Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
· Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
· Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
· Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
· Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
· Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
· Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
· Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
· Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
· Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
· Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
· Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).
· Manage the development and delivery of the portfolio of Energy/Environmental Management Programs. Keep abreast of Data Center industry innovation.

Incident and Emergency Response:
o Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
o Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
o Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.
o Ensure 24*7 shift operations in safe, secure manner without availability impact.


A day in the life
Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
• Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
• Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained.
• Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
• Perform and oversee maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations

title: Sr. TPM - Trust and Privacy, Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility (TPA)
descriptionHtml:
Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (DSTPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across a diverse set of 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

The DSTPA team is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will own end-to-end incident response and crisis management for high-severity, trust-impacting events — from detection and intake through containment, mitigation, and closure — and run the mechanisms, playbooks, and governance that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident commander during active events, drive escalations with urgency, and keep senior leadership informed with crisp, decision-ready briefs. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and anchors our continuous, cross-time-zone (follow-the-sun) coverage from the India site.

A successful candidate will have an established background leading complex, cross-functional programs under pressure, excellent program-management, problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with stakeholders at all levels. The candidate should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, possess the business judgment to make high-stakes calls in ambiguous situations, write compelling executive briefs, and drive outcomes for senior leadership. The ability to influence cross-functionally — and to hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure — will be absolutely critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities
- Act as incident commander for high-severity, trust-impacting events; own incident-command protocols, incident rooms, severity matrices, escalation pathways, and decision frameworks

- Own escalation management end to end — escalate at the right time, pull in the right owners and decision-makers, and drive issues to resolution without letting them stall

- Design, implement, and own crisis response playbooks, mechanisms, and tabletop exercises to ensure organizational readiness

- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), and track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure

- Write compelling senior-leadership and executive briefs (narratives, escalation briefs, status reports) that synthesize complex, cross-domain trust issues into clear decisions, risks, and asks

- Define, monitor, and improve operational metrics — mean time to triage, mean time to contain, mean time to resolve, and post-incident SLA compliance

- Partner with Product and Engineering to embed Trust by Design principles upstream, mitigating recurring incident patterns

- Run follow-the-sun coverage with the US team; hold cross-functional teams accountable to commitments, and mentor and develop other program managers

A day in the life
As a Senior TPM on the Trust Review & Incident Management (TRIM) team, you will own high-impact, high-visibility incident and crisis programs that directly protect our customers. You will begin by taking the handoff from the US on-call team, reviewing overnight incidents across all trust surfaces, and setting the day’s priorities. During active events you take incident command — classify severity, mobilize the right owners, drive the response, and keep leadership aligned through crisp briefs. Between events you invest in readiness: running tabletop drills, tightening playbooks, driving corrective actions to closure, and partnering with Engineering to embed Trust by Design upstream so recurring patterns stop repeating.

About the team
TRIM is a horizontal organization within DSTPA responsible for building the technologies, programs, and services at Amazon scale that instill and grow customer trust, create mechanisms to attain ever-evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can meet their trust obligations without disruption. Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function runs a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events — detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence, and we support new members across a broad mix of experience levels and tenures in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan, or experience communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

The Alloy team serves as Amazon’s central efficiency organization, leading company-wide cost optimization through intelligent and automated use of AWS resources. Our work spans thousands of internal services, enabling large-scale efficiency improvements with minimal engineering effort from partner teams. We drive optimization across multiple layers of Amazon’s stack, focusing on GPU efficiency infrastructure for AI/ML workloads through centralized scheduling, software performance profiling, and end-to-end storage optimizations through data lifecycle management. These cross-cutting initiatives transform isolated team optimizations into scalable, safe, and reusable systems that continuously improve efficiency across Amazon.

As a Software Development Engineer in Alloy , you will collaborate with service and infrastructure teams across Amazon to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks in large-scale distributed systems. You will design and build mechanisms to measure, analyze, and automate performance improvements, using data to set and drive company-wide efficiency goals. You will work closely with Principal and Distinguished Engineers, gaining exposure to Amazon’s most advanced systems while developing deep technical expertise and leadership skills. Your work will directly influence how Amazon’s software and services operate at scale, delivering measurable cost savings in the tens to hundreds of millions of dollars each year and advancing Amazon’s commitment to operational excellence and sustainability.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions across the full development lifecycle—from product definition and scoping through coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance—ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business and customer needs, translating requirements into scalable system designs that account for performance, security, and extensibility tradeoffs.
- Identify and resolve operational issues at their root cause, driving improvements to team operations and reducing support costs through proactive problem-solving and process enhancements.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools where appropriate to augment productivity and quality, applying responsible practices to refine outputs and accelerate development workflows.
- Mentor and coach fellow engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, actively training new team members on system architecture, construction, and operational best practices.

A day in the life
In this role, you will:

- Solve performance and efficiency problems that manifest at scale.
- Design metrics and measure performance and cost efficiency of services in Amazon's ecosystem.
- Collaborate with service teams to identify inefficiencies, and design and implement solutions.
- Design and develop highly available components and profiling tools.

About the team
Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly impacts Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer has a voice in technical decisions, and we encourage thoughtful debate to arrive at the best solutions. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for engineers who are excited to help shape our technical direction, grow their skills, and contribute to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。



Key job responsibilities
主な職務内容

Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
• 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
• 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
• ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
• プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力してテストなどをサポート

勤務時間

12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）



About the team
多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

ワークライフバランス

私たちはワークライフハーモニーを重視しています。仕事での成功は、家庭での犠牲を伴うべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟な勤務時間と勤務体制が私たちの文化の一部となっています。職場と家庭でサポートされていると感じるとき、クラウドで達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration
- ミッションクリティカルな設備の運用と保守に関する 2 年以上の関連実務経験（例: 24 時間稼働の工場、変電所、病院など）
- メンテナンス、変更管理、インシデント管理、ベンダー管理の経験または基本的な理解、およびポリシー、プロセス、手順を遵守して作業する方法
- 12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）
- 補助機器を使用して18 kg程度の機器を安全に持ち上げて移動できること

Preferred qualifications

- データセンターに関連する資格（CDCP、CDCS、CDCE、ASHRAE など）、またはデータセンター管理のための資格（第二種または第三種電気主任技術者、エネルギー管理士、第 4 類危険物取扱者、冷凍機械責任者、第二種電気工事士）
- プロジェクト管理資格（PMP、Prince2、ITILv2、BICSI）
- 電気システムに関する高度な理解力（変電所の電源供給システム、変圧器、スイッチギア、VFI クラス UPS、DRUPS、PDU、ATS、STS、SLA または VRLA バッテリーおよび関連システム、ディーゼル/ガスタービン発電機に関連する燃料システム、サージ制御回路、アクティブ高調波フィルター、バッテリー監視システム、分岐回路監視システム、SCADA システム）
- 機械システムに関する高度な理解力（CRAC/CRAH、AHU、チラー、冷却塔、貯蔵タンク、熱交換器、配管システム、ポンプ、バルブ、ダクトシステム、ファン、ダンパー、火災検知・消火システム、排水システム、ビル監視システム、自動制御システム）

title: Procurement Category Manager, Data Center Sourcing and Procurement (DCSP)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure team provides AWS and Amazon.com with the compute, network and datacenter capacity that are the foundations of the retail and cloud business. We are seeking a Procurement professional to support the APAC data center procurement space.

As a Procurement Category Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for the complex construction procurement and related categories and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce risks and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. Additionally, you will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category. You will also create global Procurement processes and tools to drive innovation across teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage Critical Projects (Retrofit, Remediation, Construction) Procurement category Strategy and Delivery
- Construction material supply chain sourcing and program management
- Achieve cost savings through negotiations, value engineering through the supply chain, and strategic initiatives
- Analyze category data and metrics to establish and implement procurement category strategies
- Understand trends in customer's needs and concerns across categories and regions to influence customers’ priorities
- Provide in-depth knowledge about the supply market and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically, to the business.
- Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost
- Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance
- Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships
- Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle
- Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as management of contracts post-execution

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Network Development Manager, Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.  

The Network Development Manager (NDM) leads the Terrestrial Networking (TNT) team responsible for designing, building, and operating the ground-infrastructure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) backbone network that connects ground sites — Gateway (GGW) and Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C) sites — to AWS. This leader owns the strategy, delivery, and operational health of terrestrial network connectivity: site network architecture, Direct Connect / backbone integration, device fleet (routing, switching, encryption), and the automation that scales it across regions. They manage a team of network development and systems-development engineers, partner across ground, control-plane, and security organizations, and are accountable for the availability, security, and capacity of the terrestrial network that carries customer and command traffic.


Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities

Lead the Terrestrial Networking (TNT) team that designs, builds, and operates the ground-infrastructure network connecting Ground Gateway (GGW) and Telemetry, Tracking & Command (TT&C) sites, including connectivity into Amazon Web Services (AWS).

1. Hire, develop, and retain Network Development and Systems Development Engineers; set goals, give feedback, and own team planning and roadmap execution across Operating Plan (OP1/OP2) cycles, including sustainable on-call health.
2. Drive ground-site network design and buildout (routing, switching, redundancy, and encryption such as Media Access Control Security and Internet Protocol Security).
3. Own AWS Direct Connect (DX) and backbone integration — Direct Connect Gateways, Virtual Interfaces, Internet Protocol Address Management, and Autonomous System Number / Border Gateway Protocol routing — plus region expansion and new-site turn-up through automation.
4. Review and approve network designs, change plans, and capacity decisions.
5. Own availability, performance, and security of the terrestrial network; define Service Level Objectives, lead high-severity incident response, and drive Correction of Error follow-ups.
6. Partner with ground infrastructure, control-plane, security, and AWS networking teams; represent TNT in design and Operational Readiness Reviews and leadership reporting.
7. Manage vendor, hardware, and capacity planning with supply and site-deployment teams.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of managing teams experience
- 5+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of technology role experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- Experience in managing teams
- Experience in engineering
- Experience in a technology role
- Experience with network operations either as a manager or individual contributor

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of networking
- Experience contributing to the definition and implementation of automation opportunities within an operations environment
- Experience representing your team or technical area to senior management

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Crossborder Shopping Tech
descriptionHtml:
Join a team revolutionizing how millions of customers shop globally on Amazon as a Senior Software Development Engineer for Cross Border Shopping Experience. We're building next-generation AI-powered solutions that enable customers worldwide to easily discover and purchase products across Amazon's global marketplaces through sophisticated marketing, personalization, and localization technologies.

This is an opportunity to:

1. Drive the technical design and implementation of global e-commerce features that make international shopping feel local and effortless
2. Build highly scalable solutions that help customers worldwide access Amazon's vast selection of products
3. Work on challenging problems in distributed systems, personalization, and real-time decisioning at massive scale
4. Collaborate with world-class engineers and influence technical direction across teams

If you're passionate about solving complex technical challenges at global scale and building systems that create exceptional customer experiences, we want to hear from you. Join us in transforming how the world shops across borders.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer (SDE) to join the Cross Border Customer Experience team. In this role, the SDE will design, write, and maintain user experience software for Amazon shopping pages used by millions of customers around the world. The engineer will collaborate with product managers to define the future direction of customer experience throughout the entire shopping journey (Search, Detail Page, All Offers Display, Cart, Checkout, Order Details Page) and will apply the best engineering practices to deliver working solutions for international Amazon customers. The SDE will work on customer’s international shopping journey including personalized recommendations and displaying relevant cross-border shopping information (pricing, delivery, legal) in order to enable customers to shop efficiently and with confidence while delivering on business goals. The SDE will adhere to best practices of software development in large-scale distributed systems while innovating and experimenting in an agile fashion. You will participate in the entire software lifecycle from concept, design, development, through testing, release, and maintenance. You will be mentored by tenured Amazon engineers and you will be expected to coach and mentor others around you.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy highly scalable and reliable software systems for cross-border shopping experiences used by millions of customers daily
Build technical solutions for personalized recommendations, marketing, and localized experiences supporting multiple languages, currencies, and payment methods
Drive architecture and design decisions for scalable, high-performance distributed systems
Write clean, maintainable code and conduct thorough code reviews to ensure quality
Work across the full stack - frontend and backend systems - to deliver end-to-end features
Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and UX designers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team
Optimize system performance, identify bottlenecks, and improve operational excellence
Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and availability

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Dev Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA).

Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do.

As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.

We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability
Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale
Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance
Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate
Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries
Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines
Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement
Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team
Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards
Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide.

About the team
The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager, WHS Field , Workplace Health & Safety (WHS)
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンでは、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること”というミッションを掲げ、日々改善と改革が行われています。
今回アマゾンの物流拠点/ Fulfillment Center（以下FC）にて、もっとも重視されている「安全」に対する中核部門をLeadするSite Sr. WHS Managerを募集します。オペレーション各部門と効率的に連携し、大規模FCの安全活動をLeadし安全文化を創造することで、お客様一人一人に確実に商品をお届けすることに貢献する役割を担います。

本ポジションが所属するWorkplace Health and Safety (WHS) Teamは、アマゾンの物流拠点であるFCで働くあらゆる立場の方が安全で安心した業務を行う為の環境を提供し、ルールを整備し、関係部署と連携することによって、FCの安全をLeadする部署です。現場に即した安全を提供するために、慣例に捉われず、リスクを捉えつつ剛柔な判断を行い、本来の安全を追求していきます。

Sr. WHS Managerは担当するFCの自然災害、火災、FC内でのオペレーションに関わるリスク検出をし、それらに対しての予防措置、是正措置の導入、安全に関わる事故の防止と削減を計画し、関連部署と実行していきます。また、標準化した内容をFCで実行しつつ、より効果的で効率的な方法を検討しNetwork全体へも展開します。
リスクの低減、安全教育のシステム構築や、データ解析による事故低減といった幅広い役割と責任を担いつつ活躍できるポジションです。

具体的には、担当サイトのWHS年間目標と計画作成・実施支援、リスクアセスメント、内部監査の実施、防火・防災対策の計画立案と導入を行います。また、1-3名程度の直属の部下の採用、勤怠管理、業務指導、キャリア開発、メンタル面のケア、エンゲージメントの向上に取り組んでいただきます。現場を何よりも大切にしているアマゾンであるため、Safetyのスキルをベースに自らが高い現場力を発揮することで、机上ではない安全のLeadも求められます。

更に社内のあらゆる部門と関わるだけでなく、社外のパートナーと協働で体制を構築して続けることが重要な業務となるため、Safetyのスキルだけでなく、ビジネスマナーに優れ、高いコミュニケーションでパートナーシップを築ける能力をお持ちの方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

50%：サイトにおけるWHS目標及び活動内容の計画立案と実行 (教育・訓練、監査、リスクアセスメントなど)
30%：メンバーの育成 (目標設定および実行支援、専門知識、一般知識の醸成、評価)
10%：安全にかかわる事故が発生した場合の情報収集、原因調査並びに是正対策立案・実施、是正措置の有効性の確認、NW内へのシェアと類似対策防止対策の導入。

今回アマゾンの物流拠点/ Fulfillment Center（以下FC。）にて、もっとも重視されているる「安全」に対する中核部門をLeadするSite Sr. WHS Managerを募集します。オペレーション各部門と効率的に連携し、大規模FCの安全活動をLeadし安全文化を創造することで、お客様一人一人に確実に商品をお届けすることに貢献する役割を担います。

本ポジションが所属するWHS(Workplace Health and Safety)Teamは、アマゾンの物流拠点であるFCで働くあらゆる立場の方が安全で安心した業務を行う為の環境を提供し、ルールを整備し、関係部署と連携することによって、FCの安全をLeadする部署です。現場に即した安全を提供するために、慣例に捉われず、リスクを捉えつつ剛柔な判断を行い、本来の安全を追求していきます。

Sr. WHS Managerは担当するFCの自然災害、火災、FC内でのオペレーションに関わるリスク検出をし、それらに対しての予防措置、是正措置の導入、安全に関わる事故の防止と削減を計画し、関連部署と実行していきます。また、標準化した内容をFCで実行しつつ、より効果的で効率的な方法を検討しNetwork全体へも展開します。リスクの低減、教育システムの構築や、データ解析による事故低減といった幅広い役割と責任を担いつつ活躍できるポジションです。

更に社内のあらゆる部門と関わるだけでなく、社外のパートナーと協働で体制を構築して続けることが重要な業務となるため、Safetyのスキルだけでなく、ビジネスマナーに優れ、高いコミュニケーションでパートナーシップを築ける能力をお持ちの方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

title: NW Deployment Build Lead, Global Network Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Services team provides comprehensive technical support throughout the design, planning, delivery, and operation of Amazon Web Services infrastructure. We support data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure the customers of Amazon Web Services have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations technical support managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across Amazon and our operating partners to help Amazon Web Services deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for the customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Project Lead to join our growing team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The candidate will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to develop innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand.

The position responsibilities will include scaling support of several data center locations and be responsible for day to day assistance with capacity management. The Network Project Lead will work closely with both internal stakeholders and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers, Network Deployment Planning team, infrastructure supply chain & procurement and network engineering team.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.

In addition, this role may require international travels to support other cluster’s projects.

Key job responsibilities
1. Strategic Planning & Design Management

Contribute in developing comprehensive 6-8 months network implementation roadmaps aligned with AWS DC expansion targets
Create and optimize network position layouts and rack placement strategies for data centre floor space utilization
Review and contribute to High-Level Design (HLD) documentation
Coordinate with engineering teams to validate technical requirements and design specifications
Develop capacity planning models to ensure infrastructure scalability
Create standardized planning templates and methodologies for network implementations


2. Project & Resource Management

Lead end-to-end project planning for multiple concurrent network implementation initiatives
Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, milestones, and dependencies
Manage project scope, and quality parameters
Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies
Improvise and optimize planning by incorporating lessons learnt of latest deployed projects, iteratively.
Coordinate across cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on project deliverables
Track and report weekly project progress and/or otherwise informed to key stakeholders


3. Supply Chain & Inventory Planning

Develop project inventory forecasts and requirements
Optimize developed counts by utilizing prior surplus spares.
Coordinate with procurement teams for strategic resource acquisition
Manage vendor relationships and delivery schedules
Establish and stick to procurement timelines aligned with project schedules


4. Program Governance & Process Excellence

Establish and maintain project management frameworks and best practices
Develop sustainable and repeatable planning processes
Create and maintain project documentation and reporting standards
Drive continuous improvement initiatives in planning methodologies
Build and maintain stakeholder communication channels
Coordinate with regional teams for standardized planning approaches and optimized lesson learnt based iterative optimized planning.

About the team
About Amazon Web Services
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Web Services values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Web Services?
Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Amazon Web Services pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust Amazon Web Services’ robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Amazon Web Services values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Inspector
descriptionHtml:
Come and build the future with us. Our mission is to keep AWS customers safe and secure by helping them detect and remediate vulnerabilities at never before seen scale.

Amazon Inspector helps AWS customers improve their security posture by continuously monitoring their cloud infrastructure and associated workloads against vulnerabilities and exposures. When it comes to security, time is of the essence. Our goal is to help our customers quickly discover and remediate vulnerabilities that poses the greatest risk to their organization.

We are innovating new ways of building massively scalable and globally distributed security systems for assisting our customers with security and compliance. Security Services are crucial for long-term success of AWS and it is the future of AWS. We are rapidly expanding our team to meet our fast growing needs.

The ideal candidate will look like this….

**Be fun to work with**. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.

**Have a deep understanding of software architecture and development methodology.**The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a software development engineer. You will enjoy keeping your technical skills current, to the point that you can contribute to architecture discussions. You regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting exercises and drive technical postmortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues.

**Have strong project management experience.**The successful candidate will be able to create roadmap and estimation for the project. This will include innovating and inventing new value-add services layered on top of our existing services. Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.

**Know how to run a tight, lean, efficient operation.**The right candidate will want to measure everything. You will excel at using metrics, monitoring, and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of the team. On-call responsibility is part of this job profile


Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

About the team
About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic Account Services - Premium Beauty
descriptionHtml:

You will build and execute strategic joint business plans, collaborating with Sellers to identify new selection, merchandising, traffic/conversion drivers, and operational improvements.

The ideal candidate has strong client management skills, works backwards from Seller needs to prioritize the right inputs/outputs, manages multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment, and participates in continuous improvement initiatives. They embrace ambiguity, demonstrate ownership, and advocate for their Sellers' experience on the Amazon Store.

Business Growth
- Identify and address business input metrics hindering growth; develop and test solutions before scaling
- Analyze data and trends to maximize long-term potential for your Seller portfolio
- Act as a strategic partner—proactively identify opportunities, create tailored recommendations using consultative, out-of-the-box thinking
- Lead business strategy development and long-term account plans, collaborating cross-functionally to drive customer success

Program Process Excellence

- Improve team efficiency and optimize processes; deliver critical solutions and mechanisms independently across teams
- Help define and design tools, SOPs, and processes for Seller Services
- Identify and define feature enhancements and new products based on customer feedback, data analysis, and competitive gaps
- Aggregate themes to function as Voice of the Seller with owning teams, addressing root-cause opportunities

title: Gestionnaire senior de l'engagement | Sr Engagement Manager, Services professionnels du secteur public | Public Sector Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
Avez-vous une passion profonde pour l'utilisation de la technologie afin d'outiller les entreprises? Aimeriez-vous poursuivre une carrière qui aide les clients et les partenaires à atteindre leurs objectifs plus rapidement et à moindre coût grâce aux services infonuagiques?

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) gestionnaire principal(e) de l'engagement capable de diriger des équipes internes d'AWS, des partenaires externes et des équipes clients afin de livrer des produits et services infonuagiques AWS qui permettent à nos clients de réaliser leurs objectifs d'affaires. Vous devrez mettre à profit vos compétences en relation client et votre sens technique pour comprendre les exigences des clients et les accompagner dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Vous collaborerez avec de nombreux groupes d'intervenants pour soutenir la collecte des exigences et la définition de la portée des projets. Vous travaillerez de façon continue à mettre en œuvre de manière proactive les pratiques exemplaires pour nos clients et à cerner et combler les lacunes des projets en collaboration avec tous les échelons des organisations. Les mandats typiques comprennent : l'élaboration de stratégies infonuagiques et d'analyses de rentabilité, les évaluations d'admissibilité et de migration vers l'infonuagique, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures infonuagiques, les migrations de l'infrastructure sur site vers l'infonuagique, ainsi que l'harmonisation organisationnelle liée à l'infonuagique.
--------------------------------------------
Do you have a deep passion for utilizing technology to empower businesses? Would you like to have a career that supports customers and partners reach their outcomes faster and cheaper through Cloud Services?

We are hiring a Senior Engagement Manager capable of leading internal AWS, external partners, and customer teams to deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business outcomes. You will need to draw on your customer-facing skills and technical acumen to understand customer requirements and enable them to implement their digital transformation projects.

You will be collaborating with many stakeholder groups to support requirements gathering and scope definition. You will be working on an ongoing basis to proactively implement best practices for our customers and help identify and close project gaps working with all levels of organizations. Typical engagements include: Cloud Strategy and Business Case Development, Cloud Suitability and Migration Assessments, Cloud Architecture Design and Implementation, On-Premise to Cloud Migrations, and Cloud Organizational Alignment.

Key job responsibilities
Livraison
• Collaborer avec les équipes de vente, d'avant-vente, de formation et de soutien d'AWS sur le terrain afin de chercher à comprendre les besoins de nos clients, leur entreprise, la façon dont le succès est défini, et veiller à ce que nous dépassions les attentes en matière de développement et de livraison des résultats clients. • Planifier, organiser et gérer toutes les phases du cycle de vie des projets afin d'assurer une livraison réussie. Cela comprend l'élaboration et la gestion de plans de gouvernance de projet, de calendriers de projet, d'objectifs d'équipe, de jalons de projet, de budgets et la définition de critères de succès.
• Gérer les objectifs des mandats et diriger les équipes afin d'atteindre les résultats d'affaires des clients en gérant les enjeux, les risques, les décisions, les dépendances et les mesures à prendre.
• Travailler avec les intervenants et les équipes de vente d'AWS pour modifier la portée contractuelle, les aspects financiers et les échéanciers prévus.
• Capacité à prendre en charge les responsabilités, à travailler sous pression, à respecter les budgets et les échéances.
• Tenir les équipes internes et externes responsables, réorienter au besoin et gérer les attentes des clients tout au long des mandats.
• Travailler efficacement dans un environnement dynamique où les priorités changent et être en mesure de prendre des mesures proactives pour s'assurer que les équipes répondent aux attentes des clients ou les dépassent.
• Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et efficace de manière indépendante, tout en étant également à l'aise de contribuer au sein d'une équipe mondiale.
• Axé(e) sur les résultats, priorise les activités de travail, planifie et demeure organisé(e) afin de respecter les engagements.
• S'assurer que les équipes d'AWS et des partenaires atteignent ou dépassent les objectifs d'affaires des clients.

Solutions
• Diriger des individus, des équipes ou plusieurs groupes et jouer un rôle actif dans l'analyse des objectifs de projet, la création d'un plan pour atteindre ces objectifs, puis guider les membres de l'équipe AWS, les intervenants/experts en la matière du client et potentiellement d'autres tiers pour atteindre ces objectifs, tout en comprenant l'environnement du client et les contraintes liées à l'exécution.
• Rechercher activement des moyens d'améliorer l'efficacité et l'efficience des processus.
• Capacité à appliquer une réflexion stratégique et à démontrer une compréhension des exigences pour mener à bien l'exécution.
• Capacité à prendre des décisions guidées par les politiques, les procédures et les plans d'affaires avec un encadrement limité.

title: WHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. title: Economist, Prime Video Science, Prime Video Science
descriptionHtml:
The Prime Video Science team leverages the latest in machine learning and AI techniques combined with causal inference to bring scientific rigor to the biggest decisions in entertainment: what content to make, what to license, and where to invest. We build large-scale models that simulate how our global customer base responds to change, and we get to see that work shape what the business does.

Prime Video is an industry-leading entertainment business and a critical driver of Amazon Prime subscriptions, contributing to customer loyalty and lifetime value. We're looking for an Economist to help us design the experiments that ground our models in reality, evaluate the AI systems we build, and turn our model and experiment results into insights the business can act on. As an Economist on this team, you will design and analyze experiments, build evaluations for AI systems, and run deep-dive analyses on our models, experiments, and customer data. You will work close to science: probing why a model behaves the way it does, pressure-testing results before they reach senior leaders, and, where it helps, building your own statistical and causal models. The candidate should have strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex, ambiguous analyses into clear findings for both technical and business audiences. The successful candidate will be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and analyze randomized experiments that validate and calibrate our models and measure the impact of content and product changes.
• Build evaluations and benchmarks for the AI systems the team develops and define what "good" looks like for them.
• Run deep-dive analyses on model outputs, experiment results, and customer behavior to surface the story behind the numbers and catch issues before they reach stakeholders.
• Apply statistical modeling, causal inference, and data analysis to answer business questions and inform major investment decisions.
• Communicate findings to business, finance, engineering, and science stakeholders through clear written analyses and business-facing documents.

About the team
The Prime Video Science team is a multidisciplinary group of applied scientists, data scientists, economists, and engineers. We take on some of the hardest research questions in the business, and our work carries visibility up to the CFO/CEO level. We pursue ambitious research at the intersection of machine learning, AI, and causal inference, turning that research into innovations that improve customer experience and strengthen business profitability. Few science teams get to work on problems this hard and this impactful; if that combination excites you, we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

- PhD in economics or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of industry, consulting, government, or academic research experience
- Knowledge of at least one statistical software package such as R, Stata, Matlab, SAS
- Experience in implementing modern machine-learning methods (e.g., boosted regression trees, random forests, neural networks)
- Experience with handling of large datasets

title: Techniker/in für Arbeitssicherheit
descriptionHtml:
Arbeitsschutz und Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeitenden haben bei Amazon höchste Priorität. Unsere Safety Technicians spielen dabei eine wichtige Rolle. Diese Stelle bietet Dir einen Einstieg in den Arbeitsschutz und die Möglichkeit, Dich in einem internationalen Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Expert:innen zusammen, um Deinen Standort zu überwachen, und siehst so jeden Tag, welchen Unterschied Du für das Wohlbefinden der Menschen machst.

Key job responsibilities
- Durchführung von Risikobewertungen und Audits.
- Überwachung des Standorts, damit die Prozesse den Sicherheitsverfahren von Amazon entsprechen.
- Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Berichten zu Sicherheitskennzahlen.
- Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus Operations und dem gesamten Unternehmen.
- Unterstützung bei der Untersuchung von Unfällen und Beinaheunfällen.

A day in the life
Du arbeitest vor Ort an einem unserer Standorte. So kannst Du genau verfolgen, was passiert, und Mitarbeitende können Dir während ihrer Schichten jederzeit Fragen stellen. Bei dieser Rolle geht es darum, potenzielle Probleme zu erkennen, bevor sie auftreten. Du wirst viel Zeit damit verbringen, den Standort zu überprüfen und zu verstehen, wie die Menschen die Geräte nutzen. Indem Du verstehst, wie jede Aufgabe und jede Maschine funktioniert, kannst Du den besten Weg finden, Prozesse sicher zu gestalten. Du bist auch eine der Personen, die Sicherheitsänderungen in die Tat umsetzen — das bedeutet, dass Du eng mit vielen Menschen zusammenarbeitest. Neben Deinen täglichen und wöchentlichen Aufgaben unterstützt Du unser Operations-Team bei ad-hoc Aufgaben rund um die Arbeitssicherheit.

About the team
Das Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung des mentalen und körperlichen Wohlbefindens unserer Mitarbeitenden am Arbeitsplatz. Unser Team arbeitet mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und lokalen Behörden an allen unseren Standorten zusammen, um die Einhaltung der Amazon-Richtlinien und gesetzlichen Vorschriften sicherzustellen und die Sicherheit unserer Arbeitsumgebungen zu gewährleisten. Das Team bietet vielfältige Möglichkeiten — von Safety Technicians bis hin zu Programm Manager:innen. Unabhängig von Deiner Position trägst Du zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Sicherheitsstrategie im gesamten Netzwerk bei.
